422: #### 6.5.1 首选实现：本地 `ai_agent` 编排
423: 
424: 闲时助手不新建一套 HTTP/ASR/TTS 客户端，而是复用已集成的
425: `packages/ai_agent`。设备 App 负责交互、上下文和生命周期，`ai_agent` 负责本地
426: 消息总线、ASR、文本/视觉模型请求和 TTS 后端：
427: 
428: ```text
429: Power 短按
430:   -> vs_voice 冻结 current_record/page_context
431:   -> audio_capture 采集 16 kHz/16 bit/mono
432:   -> VAD 自动结束，或 Power 短按手动结束
433:   -> voice_channel_stop_with_text()
434:   -> 得到 question/transcript
435:   -> vs_voice 从当前 record 构造受限 Prompt
436:   -> velaclaw_client_local / message_bus 推入 ai_agent
437:   -> Agent 调用文本模型；空白页可先调用 llm_chat_vision_raw()
438:   -> 回调返回 answer/display_text
439:   -> voice_channel_speak(answer 或 display_text)
440:   -> TTS 流式写入 audio_playback
441:   -> 播报结束或返回取消，释放本轮上下文
442: ```
443: 
444: 这里的“本地 `ai_agent`”是设备内的 Agent 编排入口，不代表模型在 MCU 上离线运行。
445: 模型请求仍通过已配置的模型服务商 API 发出，但由 `ai_agent` 统一处理配置、路由、
446: TLS、响应解析、工具策略和 TTS 后端。闲时助手不经过团队自建社交会话云，也不创建
447: 社交 `session_id`。
448: 
449: #### 6.5.2 Prompt 构造顺序
450: 
451: Prompt 必须由 App 在设备端显式构造，不能把整条历史目录、Agent Memory、其他会话或
452: 隐式 Skill 上下文一并交给模型。推荐结构如下：
453: 
454: ```text
455: [SYSTEM]
456: 你是 VelaSight 的闲时语音助手。
457: 只能依据本次请求提供的记录和问题回答。
458: 记录中的情绪、表情和建议都是可能的辅助线索，不得进行身份识别、人格判断、心理或医学诊断。
459: 证据不足时明确回答“无法判断”。回答先给结论，再给一条可执行建议。
460: 请返回 JSON，不要返回 Markdown、Shell、寄存器操作或任意工具指令。
461: 字段：answer、display_text、should_speak。
462: 
463: [CONTEXT]
464: record_id: <当前记录 ID>
465: title: <标题>
466: summary: <摘要>
467: body: <正文>
468: full_transcript: <完整字幕，可能已截断>
469: timeline: <时间戳 + 字幕 + 情绪 + 置信度>
470: emotion_distribution: <情绪比例>
471: content_truncated: true|false
472: 
473: [USER QUESTION]
474: <ASR 得到的本轮问题>
475: ```
476: 
477: 空白页路径将 `[CONTEXT]` 替换为一次照片分析上下文：
478: 
479: ```text
480: [IMAGE]
481: <单张可信 JPEG，由 llm_chat_vision_raw() 处理>
482: 
483: [USER QUESTION]
484: <ASR 得到的本轮问题>
485: ```
486: 
487: 空白页照片只用于当前问答，不写入社交历史，不作为下一轮隐式上下文。照片分析结果
488: 可以先由 `llm_chat_vision_raw()` 生成短文本，再与用户问题拼入普通 Agent 请求；如果
489: 模型服务支持稳定的图文请求，也可以由 Agent 适配层一次提交图片和文本。两种方式由
490: `vs_voice` 的配置项选择，但都必须限制为一张照片。
491: 
492: #### 6.5.3 历史字段白名单和长度预算
493: 
494: `vs_history` 先读取轻量索引确认当前 `record_id`，再按 `record_key` 读取一条完整记录。
495: `vs_voice` 复制字段到自己的有界请求缓冲，禁止让 Prompt 直接引用文件缓冲或 JSON 解析
496: 树中的指针。只允许以下字段进入闲时助手：
497: 
498: | 字段 | 用途 | 处理规则 |
499: | --- | --- | --- |
500: | `record_id` | 关联当前记录 | 必须与页面选中项一致，不接受模型或网络修改 |
501: | `title` | 记录主题 | 最多 96 B |
502: | `summary` | 首选简短证据 | 最多 192 B |

738: ### 9.4 两条 AI 网络链路
739: 
740: 设备必须区分两条逻辑和配置均独立的网络链路：
741: 
742: ```text
743: 社交辅助：vs_social -> vs_cloud -> 团队自建会话云 -> 表情/ASR/文本模型/TTS
744: 闲时助手：vs_voice -> 本地 ai_agent -> 模型服务商 ASR/通用模型/TTS API
745: ```
746:

748: - 闲时链路不调用自建会话云，不创建社交 `session_id`，不把问答写成社交记录。
749: - 两条链路可使用不同域名、鉴权和超时，不能把自建云 Token 传给模型服务商，反之亦然。

751: - 两条链路共享 `wlan0`、TLS 内存和 Audio/Camera 时，由 App 状态机保证互斥。

1: /*
2:  * velaclaw_client_local.c - Flat-build local IPC client for ai_agent
3:  *
4:  * Uses direct function calls to message_bus (shared address space)
5:  * and mbus_tap to intercept outbound replies synchronously.
6:  */
7: 
8: #include <velaclaw/client.h>
9: 
10: #include <errno.h>
11: #include <pthread.h>
12: #include <semaphore.h>
13: #include <stdlib.h>
14: #include <string.h>
15: #include <syslog.h>
16: 
17: #include "core/message_bus.h"
18: #include "core/message_bus_tap.h"
19: 
20: #define TAG "velaclaw_client"
21: #define CLIENT_CHANNEL "local_client"
22: 
23: struct velaclaw_client_s {
24:     char app_id[32];
25:     pthread_mutex_t mtx;
26:     sem_t reply_sem;
27:     char* reply_text;
28:     int reply_status;
29:     void (*async_cb)(int, const char*, void*);
30:     void* async_cookie;
31: };
32: 
33: static struct velaclaw_client_s* g_client_instance;
34: 
35: static void tap_callback(const agent_msg_t* msg, void* cookie)
36: {
37:     struct velaclaw_client_s* c = (struct velaclaw_client_s*)cookie;
38:     if (!c) {
39:         return;
40:     }
41: 
42:     pthread_mutex_lock(&c->mtx);
43: 
44:     if (c->async_cb) {
45:         /* Async mode: invoke user callback directly */
46:         void (*cb)(int, const char*, void*) = c->async_cb;
47:         void* ck = c->async_cookie;
48:         c->async_cb = NULL;
49:         c->async_cookie = NULL;
50:         pthread_mutex_unlock(&c->mtx);
51: 
52:         cb(0, msg->content, ck);
53:         return;
54:     }
55: 
56:     /* Sync mode: store reply and signal */
57:     free(c->reply_text);
58:     c->reply_text = msg->content ? strdup(msg->content) : NULL;
59:     c->reply_status = 0;
60:     pthread_mutex_unlock(&c->mtx);
61: 
62:     sem_post(&c->reply_sem);
63: }
64: 
65: velaclaw_client_t* velaclaw_client_open(const char* name)
66: {
67:     if (g_client_instance) {
68:         return g_client_instance;
69:     }
70: 
71:     /* Check if message_bus is alive by trying a dummy operation */
72:     agent_msg_t probe = { 0 };
73:     strncpy(probe.channel, "__probe__", sizeof(probe.channel) - 1);
74: 
75:     /* We can't easily probe, so just assume agent is running if
76:      * mbus_tap_register succeeds (it uses the same global state) */
77: 
78:     struct velaclaw_client_s* c = calloc(1, sizeof(*c));
79:     if (!c) {
80:         return NULL;
81:     }
82: 
83:     strncpy(c->app_id, name ? name : "app", sizeof(c->app_id) - 1);
84:     pthread_mutex_init(&c->mtx, NULL);
85:     sem_init(&c->reply_sem, 0, 0);
86:     c->reply_text = NULL;
87:     c->reply_status = 0;
88: 
89:     if (mbus_tap_register(CLIENT_CHANNEL, tap_callback, c) != OK) {
90:         syslog(LOG_ERR, "[%s] tap register failed (agent not running?)\n", TAG);
91:         sem_destroy(&c->reply_sem);
92:         pthread_mutex_destroy(&c->mtx);
93:         free(c);
94:         return NULL;
95:     }
96: 
97:     g_client_instance = c;
98:     syslog(LOG_INFO, "[%s] client opened: %s\n", TAG, c->app_id);
99:     return c;
100: }
101: 
102: void velaclaw_client_close(velaclaw_client_t* c)
103: {
104:     if (!c) {
105:         return;
106:     }
107: 
108:     mbus_tap_unregister(CLIENT_CHANNEL);
109: 
110:     pthread_mutex_destroy(&c->mtx);
111:     sem_destroy(&c->reply_sem);
112:     free(c->reply_text);
113:     c->reply_text = NULL;
114: 
115:     if (g_client_instance == c) {
116:         g_client_instance = NULL;
117:     }
118: 
119:     free(c);
120:     syslog(LOG_INFO, "[%s] client closed\n", TAG);
121: }
122: 
123: int velaclaw_ask(velaclaw_client_t* c,
124:     const velaclaw_ask_req_t* req,
125:     void (*cb)(int, const char*, void*), void* cookie)
126: {
127:     if (!c || !req || !req->text) {
128:         return -EINVAL;
129:     }
130: 
131:     /* Set up async callback */
132:     pthread_mutex_lock(&c->mtx);
133:     c->async_cb = cb;
134:     c->async_cookie = cookie;
135:     pthread_mutex_unlock(&c->mtx);
136: 
137:     /* Push message to agent inbound queue */
138:     agent_msg_t msg = { 0 };
139:     strncpy(msg.channel, CLIENT_CHANNEL, sizeof(msg.channel) - 1);
140:     strncpy(msg.chat_id, c->app_id, sizeof(msg.chat_id) - 1);
141:     msg.content = strdup(req->text);
142:     if (!msg.content) {
143:         return -ENOMEM;
144:     }
145: 
146:     int ret = message_bus_push_inbound(&msg);
147:     if (ret != OK) {
148:         free(msg.content);
149:         pthread_mutex_lock(&c->mtx);
150:         c->async_cb = NULL;
151:         c->async_cookie = NULL;
152:         pthread_mutex_unlock(&c->mtx);
153:         return -EIO;
154:     }
155: 
156:     return 0;
157: }

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)
+CONTEST_ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd -P)
+SDK_ROOT="$CONTEST_ROOT/bk_avdk_smp"
+OPENVELA_ROOT="$CONTEST_ROOT/contest"
+AP_CONFIG="vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/ai_agent"
+AP_OUT="$OPENVELA_ROOT/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_ai_agent"
+PACKAGE="$SDK_ROOT/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/all-app.bin"
+AP_BIN="$AP_OUT/nuttx.bin"
+AP_INPUT="$SDK_ROOT/build/openvela-ap.bin"
+AP_PACKED="$SDK_ROOT/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/tmp/app1.bin"
+LOG_DIR="$SCRIPT_DIR/logs/runtime"
+
+PORT=${VELASIGHT_PORT:-/dev/ttyUSB0}
+PORT_NUM=${VELASIGHT_PORT_NUM:-}
+FLASH_BAUD=${VELASIGHT_FLASH_BAUD:-1500000}
+CONSOLE_BAUD=${VELASIGHT_CONSOLE_BAUD:-115200}
+BOOT_LOG_SECONDS=${VELASIGHT_BOOT_LOG_SECONDS:-25}
+DO_FLASH=0
+
+die()
+{
+  printf 'error: %s\n' "$*" >&2
+  exit 1
+}
+
+usage()
+{
+  printf '%s\n' \
+    'usage: build_and_flash.sh [--flash] [-p port] [-n loader-port]' \
+    '       [--boot-log-seconds seconds]' \
+    'Builds ai_agent, regenerates the 2992K-aligned AP layout, packages all-app.bin,' \
+    'and optionally flashes it with the shell-based autoflash workflow.'
+}
+
+while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do
+  case "$1" in
+    --flash) DO_FLASH=1 ;;
+    -p) shift; PORT=$1 ;;
+    -n) shift; PORT_NUM=$1 ;;
+    --boot-log-seconds) shift; BOOT_LOG_SECONDS=$1 ;;
+    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
+    *) die "unknown argument: $1" ;;
+  esac
+  shift
done
+
+command -v podman >/dev/null 2>&1 || die 'podman is required'
+command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1 || die 'sha256sum is required'
+command -v cmp >/dev/null 2>&1 || die 'cmp is required'
+
+cd "$OPENVELA_ROOT"
+./build.sh "$AP_CONFIG" --cmake distclean
+./build.sh "$AP_CONFIG" --cmake -j8
+
+test -s "$AP_BIN" || die "missing AP binary: $AP_BIN"
+grep -q '^CONFIG_LV_TXT_ENC_UTF8=y$' "$AP_OUT/.config" || die 'UTF-8 is disabled'
+grep -q '^CONFIG_VS_SHORT_PRESS_MAX_MS=500$' "$AP_OUT/.config" || die 'short-press limit is not 500 ms'
+grep -q 'velasight_font_16_ui' "$AP_OUT/System.map" || die 'UI font is not linked'
+grep -q 'voice_vad_process' "$AP_OUT/System.map" || die 'VAD is not linked'
+grep -q 'velaclaw_client_open' "$AP_OUT/System.map" || die 'local ai_agent client is not linked'
+
+mkdir -p "$(dirname -- "$AP_INPUT")"
+cp -- "$AP_BIN" "$AP_INPUT"
+
+cd "$SDK_ROOT"
+make -C projects/app_ab clean
+podman run --rm --userns=keep-id \
+  -v "$SDK_ROOT:/armino" \
+  -w /armino \
+  localhost/bekencorp/armino-idk:1.5 \
+  make -C projects/app_ab bk7258 \
+  SDK_DIR=/armino \
+  EXTERNAL_AP_BIN=/armino/build/openvela-ap.bin
+
+PARTITIONS="$SDK_ROOT/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/partitions/partitions.txt"
test -f "$PARTITIONS" || die 'generated partitions.txt is missing'
grep -q 'primary_ap_app.*2992K' "$PARTITIONS" || die 'AP partition is not 2992K'
test -s "$PACKAGE" || die 'all-app.bin is missing'
test -s "$AP_PACKED" || die 'packed AP input is missing'
cmp -s "$AP_BIN" "$AP_INPUT" || die 'external AP copy differs'
cmp -s "$AP_BIN" "$AP_PACKED" || die 'packed AP input differs'
+
+IMAGE_SIZE=$(stat -c%s -- "$PACKAGE")
+IMAGE_SHA=$(sha256sum -- "$PACKAGE" | cut -d' ' -f1)
printf 'final package: %s bytes\n' "$IMAGE_SIZE"
printf 'final SHA256: %s\n' "$IMAGE_SHA"
printf 'AP SHA256: %s\n' "$(sha256sum -- "$AP_BIN" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
+
+if [ "$DO_FLASH" -eq 1 ]; then
+  cd "$SCRIPT_DIR"
+  FLASH_ARGS=(-b "$FLASH_BAUD" -B "$CONSOLE_BAUD" -p "$PORT")
+  if [ -n "$PORT_NUM" ]; then
+    FLASH_ARGS+=(-n "$PORT_NUM")
+  fi
+  AUTOFLASH_EXPECTED_SIZE="$IMAGE_SIZE" \
+    ./autoflash.sh "${FLASH_ARGS[@]}"
+
+  mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
+  BOOT_LOG="$LOG_DIR/velasight-final-boot-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).log"
+  stty -F "$PORT" "$CONSOLE_BAUD" cs8 -cstopb -parenb raw -echo -crtscts
+  timeout --foreground "$BOOT_LOG_SECONDS" tee "$BOOT_LOG" < "$PORT" >/dev/null &
+  CAPTURE_PID=$!
+  sleep 0.5
+  printf '\035' > "$PORT"
+  sleep 0.05
+  printf '.' > "$PORT"
+  sleep 0.05
+  printf '\r\n' > "$PORT"
+  sleep 0.05
+  printf 'reboot\r\n' > "$PORT"
+  wait "$CAPTURE_PID" || true
+  printf 'boot log: %s\n' "$BOOT_LOG"
+  tr '\r' '\n' < "$BOOT_LOG" | tee "${BOOT_LOG%.log}.normalized.log"
+fi
*** End Patch

已完成本轮修改、构建、打包、烧录和启动验证。

**已修复**

- 中文方框问题
  - 根因是旧 `lv_font_simsun_16_cjk.c` 实际只有约 1166 个稀疏汉字，不是完整 CJK 字库。
  - 新增 `velasight_font_16_ui.c`，使用 SimHei 16 px 生成，覆盖当前页面中文和 ASCII：
    - 社交模式
    - 请按住
    - 退出社交
    - 网络切换
    - 历史记录
    - 选择
    - 状态
    - 记录
    - 错误
    - 重试
    - 切换 AP/STA

  - 已移除完整 SimSun 默认字体配置，减少固件占用。

- 短按上限
  - `CONFIG_VS_SHORT_PRESS_MAX_MS` 已改为 `500`。
  - 超过 `500 ms` 不再识别为短按，而是进入取消路径。

```text
CONFIG_VS_SHORT_PRESS_MAX_MS=500
CONFIG_LV_TXT_ENC_UTF8=y

130: static void vs_handle_event(struct vs_display_s *display,
131:                             struct vs_runtime_s *runtime,
132:                             struct vs_network_s *network,
133:                             const struct vs_input_event_s *event)
134: {
135:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_COMBO_PROGRESS &&
136:       (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_HISTORY ||
137:        runtime->page == VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING))
138:     {
139:       runtime->page = VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING;
140:       runtime->progress = event->progress;
141:       return;
142:     }
143: 
144:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_COMBO_CANCEL &&
145:       runtime->page == VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING &&
146:       runtime->network.mode == VS_NET_STA)
147:     {
148:       runtime->page = VS_PAGE_HISTORY;
149:       runtime->progress = 0;
150:       return;
151:     }
152: 
153:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_PROGRESS && event->key == VS_KEY_CONFIRM &&
154:       (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_HISTORY ||
155:        runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ENTER))
156:     {
157:       runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ENTER;
158:       runtime->progress = event->progress;
159:       return;
160:     }
161: 
162:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_PROGRESS && event->key == VS_KEY_BACK &&
163:       (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING ||
164:        runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSED ||
165:        runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_EXITING))
166:     {
167:       if (runtime->page != VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_EXITING)
168:         {
169:           runtime->social_exit_from_paused =
170:             runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSED;
171:         }
172: 
173:       runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_EXITING;
174:       runtime->progress = event->progress;
175:       return;
176:     }
177: 
178:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_PROGRESS && event->key == VS_KEY_BACK &&
179:       (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOFTAP ||
180:        (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING &&
181:         runtime->network.mode == VS_NET_AP)))
182:     {
183:       runtime->page = VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING;
184:       runtime->progress = event->progress;
185:       return;
186:     }
187: 
188:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_CANCEL && event->key == VS_KEY_CONFIRM &&
189:       runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ENTER)
190:     {
191:       runtime->page = VS_PAGE_HISTORY;
192:       runtime->progress = 0;
193:       return;
194:     }
195: 
196:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_CANCEL && event->key == VS_KEY_BACK &&
197:       runtime->page == VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING &&
198:       runtime->network.mode == VS_NET_AP)
199:     {
200:       runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOFTAP;
201:       runtime->progress = 0;
202:       return;
203:     }
204: 
205:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_NET_TOGGLE &&
206:       (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_HISTORY ||
207:        runtime->page == VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING) &&
208:       network != NULL)
209:     {
210:       vs_switch_network(display, runtime, network);
211:       return;
212:     }
213: 
214:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_SHORT)
215:     {
216:       if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_HISTORY)
217:         {
218:           if (event->key == VS_KEY_CONFIRM)
219:             {
220:               /* Keep a visible assistant entry page until the voice backend
221:                * is connected in the next implementation phase. */
222:               runtime->page = VS_PAGE_VOICE_LISTENING;
223:             }
224:           else if (event->key == VS_KEY_BACK)
225:             runtime->page = VS_PAGE_HISTORY;
226:           else if (event->key == VS_KEY_NEXT)
227:             {
228:               runtime->index = (runtime->index + 1) %
229:                                (sizeof(g_history) / sizeof(g_history[0]));
230:               runtime->view = VS_HISTORY_SUMMARY;
231:             }
232:         }
233:       else if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING &&
234:                event->key == VS_KEY_CONFIRM)
235:         {
236:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSED;
237:         }
238:       else if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSED &&
239:                event->key == VS_KEY_CONFIRM)
240:         {
241:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING;
242:         }
243:       else if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_VOICE_LISTENING &&
244:                event->key == VS_KEY_CONFIRM)
245:         {
246:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_VOICE_THINKING;
247:         }
248:       else if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ENTER &&
249:                event->key == VS_KEY_CONFIRM)
250:         {
251:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_VOICE_LISTENING;
252:           runtime->progress = 0;
253:         }
254:       else if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_EXITING &&
255:                event->key == VS_KEY_BACK)
256:         {
257:           runtime->page = runtime->social_exit_from_paused ?
258:                           VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSED : VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING;
259:           runtime->progress = 0;
260:         }
261:       else if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING &&
262:                runtime->network.mode == VS_NET_AP &&
263:                event->key == VS_KEY_BACK)
264:         {
265:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOFTAP;
266:           runtime->progress = 0;
267:         }
268:       else if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_VOICE_SPEAKING)
269:         {
270:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_HISTORY;
271:         }
272:       else if (event->key == VS_KEY_BACK &&
273:                runtime->page != VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING &&
274:                runtime->page != VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSED &&
275:                runtime->page != VS_PAGE_SOFTAP &&
276:                runtime->page != VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING)
277:         {
278:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_HISTORY;
279:         }
280:     }
281:   else if (event->type == VS_INPUT_LONG)
282:     {
283:       if ((runtime->page == VS_PAGE_HISTORY ||
284:            runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ENTER) &&
285:           event->key == VS_KEY_CONFIRM)
286:         {
287:           runtime->progress = 100;
288:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING;
289:         }
290:       else if ((runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING ||
291:                 runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSED ||
292:                 runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_EXITING) &&
293:                event->key == VS_KEY_BACK)
294:         {
295:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_HISTORY;
296:         }
297:       else if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOFTAP &&
298:                event->key == VS_KEY_CONFIRM)
299:         {
300:           /* Credential reset belongs to the future SoftAP service. */
301:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOFTAP;
302:         }
303:       else if ((runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOFTAP ||
304:                 (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING &&
305:                  runtime->network.mode == VS_NET_AP)) &&
306:                event->key == VS_KEY_BACK && network != NULL)
307:         {
308:           vs_switch_network(display, runtime, network);
309:         }
310:       else if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_ERROR && event->key == VS_KEY_BACK)
311:         {
312:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_HISTORY;
313:         }
314:     }
315: }

317: int vs_app_run(void)
318: {
319:   struct vs_display_s *display = NULL;
320:   struct vs_input_s *input = NULL;
321:   struct vs_network_s *network = NULL;
322:   struct vs_runtime_s runtime;
323:   struct vs_input_event_s event;
324:   int ret;
325: 
326:   memset(&runtime, 0, sizeof(runtime));
327:   runtime.page = VS_PAGE_HISTORY;
328:   runtime.view = VS_HISTORY_SUMMARY;
329:   runtime.network.mode = VS_NET_STA;
330:   runtime.network.state = VS_NET_DOWN;
331: 
332:   ret = vs_display_open(&display);
333:   if (ret < 0)
334:     return ret;
335:   ret = vs_input_open(&input);
336:   if (ret < 0)
337:     goto fail;
338:   ret = vs_network_open(&network);
339:   if (ret < 0)
340:     {
341:       runtime.network.state = VS_NET_ERROR;
342:       runtime.network.error = ret;
343:     }
344: 
345:   runtime.agent = velaclaw_client_open("velasight");
346:   if (runtime.agent == NULL)
347:     {
348:       printf("velasight: ai_agent client unavailable\n");
349:     }
350: 
351:   vs_render(display, &runtime);
352:   for (;;)
353:     {
354:       if (vs_input_poll(input, &event) > 0)
355:         {
356:           vs_handle_event(display, &runtime, network, &event);
357:           vs_render(display, &runtime);
358:         }
359:       vs_display_tick(display);
360:       usleep(CONFIG_VS_INPUT_POLL_MS * 1000);
361:     }
362: 
363: fail:
364:   vs_network_close(network);
365:   vs_input_close(input);
366:   vs_display_close(display);
367:   return ret;
368: }

95: ## 3. 按键定义
96: 
97: ### 3.1 物理映射
98: 
99: | 语义键 | 板级按键 | GPIO | 统一名称 |
100: | --- | --- | --- | --- |
101: | 确认/取消 | Power | 12 | `VS_KEY_CONFIRM` |
102: | 返回 | Volume Up | 13 | `VS_KEY_BACK` |
103: | 下一个 | Volume Down | 8 | `VS_KEY_NEXT` |
104: 
105: ### 3.2 识别参数
106: 
107: - 扫描周期：10 ms。
108: - 稳定消抖：连续 30 ms 状态一致。
109: - 短按：稳定按下至少 `CONFIG_VS_SHORT_PRESS_MIN_MS`（当前 80 ms）且不超过
110:   `CONFIG_VS_SHORT_PRESS_MAX_MS`（当前 500 ms）后释放；超过上限按取消处理。
111: - 长按：稳定按下达到 2000 ms，只发送一次 `LONG_PRESS`；释放不再补发短按。
112: - 组合长按：返回和下一个均稳定按下后开始计时，持续 2000 ms；当前代码没有独立的 150 ms 错峰窗口。
113: - 组合键成立后吞掉两个单键事件，防止同时触发返回或翻页。
114: - Power 和返回键的长按进度按 4% 粒度上报；组合键使用独立的 `VS_INPUT_COMBO_PROGRESS`，提前释放上报
115:   `VS_INPUT_COMBO_CANCEL`，达到阈值上报 `VS_INPUT_NET_TOGGLE`。
116: 
117: 阈值最终放入 Kconfig，以上数值作为首版默认值。按键 worker 只产生事件，不直接改变
118: App 状态。
119: 
120: ### 3.3 各界面行为
121: 
122: | 状态 | 确认短按 | 确认长按 | 返回短按 | 返回长按 | 下一个短按 | 返回+下一个长按 |
123: | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
124: | 历史索引 | 进入 `VOICE_LISTENING` 占位页 | 显示进度，满圈后进入社交占位页 | 保持历史页 | 保持历史页 | 下一条静态记录 | STA/AP 切换请求 |
125: | 空白历史页 | 当前代码没有独立空白页 | 同左 | 保持当前页 | 保持当前页 | 无独立空白页处理 | STA/AP 切换请求 |
126: | 语音聆听 | 手动截断并提交 | 无操作 | 立即取消 | 立即取消 | 无操作 | 禁止模式切换 |
127: | 语音识别/思考 | 无操作 | 无操作 | 立即取消在途请求 | 立即取消在途请求 | 无操作 | 禁止模式切换 |
128: | TTS 播放 | 停止播报并返回 | 无操作 | 立即取消播放并返回 | 立即取消播放并返回 | 无操作 | 禁止模式切换 |
129: | 社交采集中 | 暂停采集 | 无操作 | 无操作 | 结束并等待云结果 | 切换提示页 | 禁止模式切换 |
130: | 社交暂停 | 继续 | 无操作 | 无操作 | 结束并等待云结果 | 切换提示页 | 禁止模式切换 |
131: | 等待最终结果 | 无操作 | 无操作 | 无操作 | 可二次长按取消等待并保存 incomplete | 无操作 | 禁止模式切换 |
132: | SoftAP | 无操作 | 当前保持 SoftAP（凭据重置未接入） | 保持 SoftAP | 显示同样环形进度，长按 2 s 后返回 STA | 无操作 | 禁止模式切换 |
133: | 错误提示 | 确认重试 | 无操作 | 返回历史索引 | 无操作 | 查看下一条错误信息 | 禁止模式切换 |
134: 
135: ## 4. 状态机
136: 
137: ### 4.1 顶层状态
138: 
139: ```text
140: BOOT
141:   -> HISTORY_STA
142:       -> VOICE_LISTENING
143:       -> VOICE_THINKING
144:       -> VOICE_SPEAKING
145:       -> HISTORY_STA
146:       -> SOCIAL_ENTER
147:       -> SOCIAL_RUNNING <-> SOCIAL_PAUSED
148:       -> SOCIAL_EXITING
149:       -> HISTORY_STA
150:       -> NET_SWITCHING -> SOFTAP | ERROR
151:    any operational state -> ERROR -> HISTORY_STA
152: ```
153: 
154: - `BOOT`：初始化按键、双屏、存储索引和 STA 状态；任何单项失败都形成可显示错误，
155:   不因一块屏或一条历史损坏而崩溃。
156: - `HISTORY_STA`：默认状态。当前代码使用 `vs_app.c` 中的三条静态记录；轻量索引、完整 JSON
157:   读取和持久化尚未接入。
158: - `VOICE_LISTENING`、`VOICE_THINKING` 和 `VOICE_SPEAKING`：当前仍是 VelaSight 页面状态
159:   占位。`ai_agent` 库侧已经编译接入音频采集、RMS VAD、ASR/TTS 和本地 Agent client；
160:   VelaSight 顶层的上下文白名单、异步回答和取消生命周期尚未接入 `vs_app.c`。
161: - `VOICE_THINKING` 和 `VOICE_SPEAKING`：当前仅保留页面枚举，尚未实现问题提交、回答显示或 TTS。
162: - `SOCIAL_ENTER`：显示 Power 长按进度；短按释放进入 `VOICE_LISTENING`，长按达到 2 s 进入
163:   `SOCIAL_RUNNING`，提前释放不会启动社交业务。
164: - `SOCIAL_RUNNING`、`SOCIAL_PAUSED` 和 `SOCIAL_EXITING`：当前为本地 UI 占位状态；Power 短按
165:   在运行/暂停间切换，返回键长按显示退出环形动画并回到历史页，媒体和云端会话尚未接入。
166: - `NET_SWITCHING`：组合键进入 AP 或 AP 页面返回 STA 时显示环形进度。提前释放组合键回到历史页；
167:   AP 返回键提前释放保持 SoftAP，达到 2 s 后调用 `vs_network_request_mode()`。
168: - `SOFTAP`：当前由 `vs_network_apply_ap()` 配置 `wlan0`、IPv4 和 DHCP；页面显示 SoftAP 状态，
169:   Web Server、凭据重置和持久化配置仍未实现。

58: ## 3. 架构和资源所有权
59: 
60: ### 3.1 固定架构结论
61: 
62: - BK7258 AP 是 Cortex-M33 / ARMv8-M Mainline / Thumb / hard-float，不是 Cortex-A / ARMv8-A。
63: - 不得引入 `arch/arm64`、GIC、AArch64、generic timer、MMU/页表、TF-A/BL31 或 `OUTPUT_ARCH(aarch64)`。
64: - BK7258 是三核 AMP：物理 CPU0 运行 Armino CP，CPU1 是 OpenVela AP primary，CPU2 是 AP secondary。
65: - AP 内部 SMP 时 CPU1/CPU2 运行同一个 `nuttx.bin`，映射为 NuttX 逻辑 CPU0/CPU1。
66: - 当前运行基线是 CPU1 单核，CPU2 SMP 尚未实现。
67: 
68: ### 3.2 CPU0/CP 保留职责
69: 
70: CP 继续拥有并负责：
71: 
72: - bootloader、CP 固件和 FreeRTOS 运行环境
73: - 中央电源/时钟管理、硬件 WDT
74: - PSRAM PHY、电压、时钟、控制器和器件 ID 检测
75: - Flash 擦写编程
76: - Wi-Fi controller、RWNX/UMAC/LMAC/MAC/PHY/RF
77: - Bluetooth BTDM controller-only
78: - CP UART0 物理日志口
79: 
80: AP 不得重复执行与 CP 冲突的 PHY、时钟、电源或控制器初始化。
81: 
82: ### 3.3 内存地址来源
83: 
84: Flash、SRAM、PSRAM 和保留区地址来自目标 `app_ab` 分区生成结果，不是 BK7258 芯片常量：
85: 
86: ```text
87: AP Flash XIP:    0x02150000 (当前 app_ab 布局)
88: AP 私有 SRAM:    0x28010000..0x28064000 (336 KiB)
89: AP_SPINLOCK:     0x28000000..0x2800ffff
90: CP_RAM:          0x28064000..0x2809f6ff
91: PWR_MNG:         0x2809f700..0x2809f7ff
92: PSRAM 窗口:      0x60000000..0x60ffffff (当前 16 MiB 布局)
93: ```
94: 
95: AP 不得清零 CP_RAM、PWR_MNG、SWAP，不得把 `AP_SPINLOCK` 放入 heap，不得覆盖 CP 的 128 KiB PSRAM heap。

98: 
99: AP 镜像只能通过 `EXTERNAL_AP_BIN` 接口注入打包流程，不得手工覆盖 `package/tmp/app1.bin`。

101: ### 3.5 AP 控制台
102: 
103: 正式 AP 日志路径是 Mailbox UART -> CP UART0。物理 UART1 不是交付控制台，不接管 GPIO0/1。

154: ## 6. 开发工作流
155: 
156: 1. 读取任务路由中对应方案和 GitHub 指南。
157: 2. 确认修改目标在 `board/beken/` 内，不在参考目录。
158: 3. 确认改动不违反第 3 节架构约束。
159: 4. 实现改动，Make 和 CMake 源列表必须一致。
160: 5. 按第 7 节构建和验证。
161: 6. 通过验证后按第 9 节提交。
162: 7. 每次完成更改后都需 commit 到 `dev-ai-contest-2026` 分支。

164: ## 7. 构建与打包门禁
165: 
166: ### 7.1 OpenVela AP 构建
167: 
168: 本项目有两个不同的板级配置：`nsh` 仅用于最小启动/底层对照，`ai_agent`
169: 用于 VelaSight 产品固件。早期门禁命令保留 `nsh` 是因为它先完成了 AP
170: 基础启动验证；当前包含 VelaSight、LVGL 和中文界面的最终镜像必须使用
171: `ai_agent`。两者的 `.config`、输出目录和固件内容不能混用。
172: 
173: ```bash
174: cd /home/mi/vela_competition/contest
175: 
176: ./build.sh \
177:   vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/ai_agent \
178:   --cmake \
179:   -j8
180: ```
181: 
182: 修改过 `Kconfig` 或 `defconfig` 时先执行：
183: 
184: ```bash
185: ./build.sh \
186:   vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/ai_agent \
187:   --cmake distclean
188: ```
189: 
190: 输出：
191: 
192: ```text
193: contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_ai_agent/nuttx       # ELF
194: contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_ai_agent/nuttx.bin   # AP raw binary
195: contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_ai_agent/System.map
196: ```

198: ### 7.2 准备外部 AP 输入

已修复并烧录最终版本。

**根因**

1. `vs_input.c` 的长按判断原本放在按键状态变化分支中，只有按键释放时才可能判断长按。
   按住达到 2 秒时不会及时产生 `VS_INPUT_LONG`，所以长按动作不生效。

2. 错误页没有进入返回键进度处理路径，LVGL 圆环没有被显示和更新。

3. 错误页判断依赖网络当前 mode。AP 切换失败时 mode 可能仍是 STA，导致错误页的返回键事件被过滤。

**修复内容**

- 长按达到 `2000 ms` 时，在按键仍保持按下期间立即生成一次 `VS_INPUT_LONG`。
- 长按过程中继续生成 `VS_INPUT_PROGRESS`，圆环按 4% 粒度更新。
- 错误页支持：
  - 返回键短按：立即返回历史记录。
  - 返回键长按：显示圆环进度，达到 2 秒后返回历史记录。
  - 长按提前释放：取消圆环，保持错误页。
- 切换网络时清理旧的错误页进度，避免圆环残留。
- 增加输入诊断日志：

velasight: input type=%u key=%u progress=%u page=%u->%u

95:  * Name: vp_read_request
96:  *
97:  * Description:
98:  *   Read until the headers plus the declared body have arrived, the cap is
99:  *   reached or the deadline passes.  Returns the total length, or negative on
100:  *   error.  A client that opens a connection and says nothing costs one
101:  *   timeout, not the service.
102:  *
103:  ****************************************************************************/
104: 
105: static int vp_read_request(int fd, struct vp_http_request_s *req)
106: {
107:   size_t total = 0;
108:   int waited = 0;
109: 
110:   for (; ; )
111:     {
112:       struct pollfd pfd;
113:       ssize_t n;
114:       int ret;
115: 
116:       ret = vp_http_parse(g_request, total, req);
117:       if (ret == 0)
118:         {
119:           if (req->action != VP_HTTP_ACTION_SAVE ||
120:               total >= req->header_len + req->content_length)
121:             {
122:               return (int)total;
123:             }
124:         }
125:       else if (ret != -EAGAIN)
126:         {
127:           return ret;
128:         }
129: 
130:       if (total >= sizeof(g_request) - 1)
131:         {
132:           return -E2BIG;
133:         }
134: 
135:       pfd.fd = fd;
136:       pfd.events = POLLIN;
137:       pfd.revents = 0;
138:       ret = poll(&pfd, 1, VP_ACCEPT_POLL_MS);
139:       if (ret < 0)
140:         {
141:           if (errno == EINTR)
142:             {
143:               continue;
144:             }
145: 
146:           return -errno;
147:         }
148: 
149:       if (ret == 0)
150:         {
151:           waited += VP_ACCEPT_POLL_MS;
152:           if (waited >= VP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS)
153:             {
154:               return -ETIMEDOUT;
155:             }
156: 
157:           continue;
158:         }
159: 
160:       n = read(fd, g_request + total, sizeof(g_request) - 1 - total);
161:       if (n < 0)
162:         {
163:           if (errno == EINTR)
164:             {
165:               continue;
166:             }
167: 
168:           return -errno;
169:         }
170: 
171:       if (n == 0)

173:           /* Peer closed.  Whatever arrived is all there will be, so let the
174:            * parser decide between "incomplete" and "answerable".
175:            */

177:           if (vp_http_parse(g_request, total, req) == 0 &&
178:               (req->action != VP_HTTP_ACTION_SAVE ||

298: static void *vp_thread(void *arg)
299: {
300:   (void)arg;
301: 
302:   for (; ; )
303:     {
304:       struct pollfd pfd;
305:       uint32_t generation = 0;
306:       int save_status = 0;
307:       bool saved = false;
308:       bool stopping;
309:       int fd;
310:       int ret;
311: 
312:       pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
313:       stopping = g_server.stopping;
314:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
315:       if (stopping)
316:         {
317:           break;
318:         }
319: 
320:       pfd.fd = g_server.listenfd;
321:       pfd.events = POLLIN;
322:       pfd.revents = 0;
323: 
324:       /* Polling rather than blocking in accept(): stop() then needs no signal
325:        * and no socket shutdown trick that may or may not wake accept on a
326:        * given stack.
327:        *
328:        * This requires CONFIG_NET_TCPBACKLOG on NuttX, which the Kconfig
329:        * depends on.  Without it TCP_BACKLOG events never fire, POLLIN on a
330:        * listening socket is unreachable, and accept() blocks with no timeout
331:        * at all -- measured on the board as a service that reported
332:        * "listening" and then answered nothing.
333:        */
334: 
335:       ret = poll(&pfd, 1, VP_ACCEPT_POLL_MS);
336:       if (ret < 0)
337:         {
338:           if (errno == EINTR)
339:             {
340:               continue;
341:             }
342: 
343:           break;
344:         }
345: 
346:       if (ret == 0)
347:         {
348:           continue;
349:         }
350: 
351:       fd = accept(g_server.listenfd, NULL, NULL);
352:       if (fd < 0)
353:         {
354:           if (errno == EINTR || errno == ECONNABORTED)
355:             {
356:               continue;
357:             }
358: 
359:           break;
360:         }
361: 
362:       vp_handle(fd, &saved, &save_status, &generation);
363: 
364:       /* Close before notifying.  The application is expected to leave SoftAP
365:        * from the callback, and doing that with the response still in flight is
366:        * what makes a successful save look like a failed submit on the phone.
367:        */
368: 
369:       shutdown(fd, SHUT_RDWR);
370:       close(fd);
371: 
372:       if (saved)
373:         {
374:           pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
375:           g_server.generation = generation;
376:           pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
377:         }
378: 
379:       if (saved || save_status < 0)
380:         {
381:           if (g_server.on_saved != NULL)
382:             {
383:               g_server.on_saved(save_status, generation, g_server.cb_arg);
384:             }
385:         }
386: 
387:       if (saved && g_server.one_shot)
388:         {
389:           break;
390:         }
391: 
392:       pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
393:       stopping = g_server.stopping;
394:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
395:       if (stopping)
396:         {
397:           break;
398:         }
399:     }
400: 
401:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
402:   if (g_server.listenfd >= 0)
403:     {
404:       close(g_server.listenfd);
405:       g_server.listenfd = -1;
406:     }
407: 
408:   g_server.state = VP_STATE_FINISHED;
409:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
410:   return NULL;
411: }

415: static void vp_reap_locked(void)
416: {
417:   if (g_server.state == VP_STATE_FINISHED)
418:     {
419:       pthread_t thread = g_server.thread;
420: 
421:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
422:       pthread_join(thread, NULL);
423:       pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
424:       g_server.state = VP_STATE_IDLE;
425:     }

428: int velasight_provisioning_start(
429:     const struct velasight_prov_config_s *config)
430: {
431:   struct velasight_prov_config_s cfg;
432:   struct sockaddr_in addr;
433:   pthread_attr_t attr;
434:   uint16_t port;
435:   int one = 1;
436:   int fd;
437:   int ret;
438: 
439:   memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
440:   if (config != NULL)
441:     {
442:       cfg = *config;
443:     }
444: 
445:   if (cfg.store_path != NULL &&
446:       strlen(cfg.store_path) >= VP_STORE_PATH_MAX)
447:     {
448:       return -ENAMETOOLONG;
449:     }
450: 
451:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
452:   vp_reap_locked();
453:   if (g_server.state != VP_STATE_IDLE)
454:     {
455:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
456:       return -EALREADY;
457:     }
458: 
459:   port = cfg.port != 0 ? cfg.port :
460:          (uint16_t)CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_PORT;
461: 
462:   fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
463:   if (fd < 0)
464:     {
465:       ret = -errno;
466:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
467:       return ret;
468:     }
469: 
470:   setsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, &one, sizeof(one));
471: 
472:   memset(&addr, 0, sizeof(addr));
473:   addr.sin_family      = AF_INET;
474:   addr.sin_port        = htons(port);
475:   addr.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_ANY);
476: 
477:   if (bind(fd, (struct sockaddr *)&addr, sizeof(addr)) < 0 ||
478:       listen(fd, 2) < 0)
479:     {
480:       ret = -errno;
481:       close(fd);
482:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
483:       return ret;
484:     }
485: 
486:   g_server.listenfd   = fd;
487:   g_server.stopping   = false;
488:   g_server.one_shot   = cfg.one_shot;
489:   g_server.generation = 0;
490:   g_server.on_saved   = cfg.on_saved;
491:   g_server.cb_arg     = cfg.cb_arg;
492:   snprintf(g_server.store_path, sizeof(g_server.store_path), "%s",
493:            cfg.store_path != NULL ? cfg.store_path :
494:            CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_STORE);
495: 
496:   pthread_attr_init(&attr);
497:   pthread_attr_setstacksize(&attr, VP_THREAD_STACK);
498:   ret = pthread_create(&g_server.thread, &attr, vp_thread, NULL);
499:   pthread_attr_destroy(&attr);
500:   if (ret != 0)
501:     {
502:       close(fd);
503:       g_server.listenfd = -1;
504:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
505:       return -ret;
506:     }
507: 
508:   g_server.state = VP_STATE_RUNNING;
509:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
510: 
511:   printf("provision_web: listening on 0.0.0.0:%u, store %s\n",
512:          (unsigned)port, g_server.store_path);
513:   return 0;
514: }

516: int velasight_provisioning_stop(void)
517: {
518:   pthread_t thread;
519: 
520:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
521:   vp_reap_locked();
522:   if (g_server.state != VP_STATE_RUNNING)
523:     {
524:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
525:       return -EALREADY;
526:     }
527: 
528:   g_server.stopping = true;
529:   thread = g_server.thread;
530: 
531:   /* Called from the saved callback, which runs on the listener thread: joining
532:    * ourselves would deadlock, so only ask the loop to end and let the normal
533:    * exit path close the socket.  A later stop() from the application reaps it.
534:    */
535: 
536:   if (pthread_equal(thread, pthread_self()))
537:     {
538:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
539:       return 0;
540:     }
541: 
542:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
543:   pthread_join(thread, NULL);
544: 
545:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
546:   g_server.state = VP_STATE_IDLE;
547:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
548:   return 0;
549: }

557:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
558:   return running;

16: #define VP_OFF_MAGIC     0
17: #define VP_OFF_VERSION   4
18: #define VP_OFF_FLAGS     6
19: #define VP_OFF_GEN       8
20: #define VP_OFF_SSID_LEN  12
21: #define VP_OFF_PSK_LEN   13
22: #define VP_OFF_SSID      14
23: #define VP_OFF_PSK       46
24: #define VP_OFF_RESERVED  109

29: uint32_t vp_crc32(const void *data, size_t len)
30: {
31:   const unsigned char *p = (const unsigned char *)data;
32:   uint32_t crc = 0xffffffffu;
33:   size_t i;
34: 
35:   /* Bitwise rather than a table: 114 bytes twice per save is not worth 1KB of
36:    * flash on a part that is already at 90% of its region.
37:    */
38: 
39:   for (i = 0; i < len; i++)
40:     {
41:       unsigned bit;
42: 
43:       crc ^= p[i];
44:       for (bit = 0; bit < 8; bit++)
45:         {
46:           crc = (crc >> 1) ^ (0xedb88320u & (uint32_t)(-(int32_t)(crc & 1u)));
47:         }
48:     }
49: 
50:   return crc ^ 0xffffffffu;
51: }
52: 
53: static void vp_put16(uint8_t *buf, uint16_t value)
54: {
55:   buf[0] = (uint8_t)(value & 0xffu);
56:   buf[1] = (uint8_t)((value >> 8) & 0xffu);
57: }
58: 
59: static void vp_put32(uint8_t *buf, uint32_t value)
60: {
61:   buf[0] = (uint8_t)(value & 0xffu);
62:   buf[1] = (uint8_t)((value >> 8) & 0xffu);
63:   buf[2] = (uint8_t)((value >> 16) & 0xffu);
64:   buf[3] = (uint8_t)((value >> 24) & 0xffu);
65: }
66: 
67: static uint16_t vp_get16(const uint8_t *buf)
68: {
69:   return (uint16_t)((uint16_t)buf[0] | (uint16_t)((uint16_t)buf[1] << 8));
70: }
71: 
72: static uint32_t vp_get32(const uint8_t *buf)
73: {
74:   return (uint32_t)buf[0] | ((uint32_t)buf[1] << 8) |
75:          ((uint32_t)buf[2] << 16) | ((uint32_t)buf[3] << 24);
76: }

79: {

90: int vp_record_encode(uint8_t *buf, size_t buflen,
91:                      const struct velasight_prov_credentials_s *cred)
92: {
93:   size_t ssid_len;
94:   size_t psk_len;
95:   int ret;
96: 
97:   if (buf == NULL || cred == NULL)
98:     {
99:       return -EINVAL;
100:     }
101: 
102:   if (buflen < VP_RECORD_SIZE)
103:     {
104:       return -E2BIG;
105:     }
106: 
107:   ret = vp_credentials_validate(cred);
108:   if (ret < 0)
109:     {
110:       return ret;
111:     }
112: 
113:   ssid_len = vp_len(cred->ssid, sizeof(cred->ssid));
114:   psk_len  = vp_len(cred->password, sizeof(cred->password));
115: 
116:   memset(buf, 0, VP_RECORD_SIZE);
117:   memcpy(buf + VP_OFF_MAGIC, VP_RECORD_MAGIC, 4);
118:   vp_put16(buf + VP_OFF_VERSION, VP_RECORD_VERSION);
119:   vp_put16(buf + VP_OFF_FLAGS,
120:            cred->open_network ? VP_RECORD_FLAG_OPEN : 0);
121:   vp_put32(buf + VP_OFF_GEN, cred->generation);
122:   buf[VP_OFF_SSID_LEN] = (uint8_t)ssid_len;
123:   buf[VP_OFF_PSK_LEN]  = (uint8_t)psk_len;
124:   memcpy(buf + VP_OFF_SSID, cred->ssid, ssid_len);
125:   memcpy(buf + VP_OFF_PSK, cred->password, psk_len);
126:   vp_put32(buf + VP_OFF_CRC, vp_crc32(buf, VP_RECORD_SIZE - 4));
127:   return VP_RECORD_SIZE;
128: }

130: static bool vp_padding_is_zero(const uint8_t *buf, size_t offset,
131:                                size_t used, size_t field)
132: {
133:   size_t i;
134: 
135:   for (i = used; i < field; i++)
136:     {
137:       if (buf[offset + i] != 0)
138:         {
139:           return false;
140:         }
141:     }
142: 
143:   return true;
144: }

146: int vp_record_decode(const uint8_t *buf, size_t len,
147:                      struct velasight_prov_credentials_s *cred)
148: {
149:   struct velasight_prov_credentials_s parsed;
150:   size_t ssid_len;
151:   size_t psk_len;
152:   uint16_t flags;
153: 
154:   if (buf == NULL || cred == NULL)
155:     {
156:       return -EINVAL;
157:     }
158: 
159:   /* Exactly one size is legal.  A shorter file is a truncated write and a
160:    * longer one is not this format, and neither is worth guessing about.
161:    */
162: 
163:   if (len != VP_RECORD_SIZE)
164:     {
165:       return -EBADMSG;
166:     }
167: 
168:   if (memcmp(buf + VP_OFF_MAGIC, VP_RECORD_MAGIC, 4) != 0 ||
169:       vp_get16(buf + VP_OFF_VERSION) != VP_RECORD_VERSION ||
170:       buf[VP_OFF_RESERVED] != 0)
171:     {
172:       return -EBADMSG;
173:     }
174: 
175:   if (vp_get32(buf + VP_OFF_CRC) != vp_crc32(buf, VP_RECORD_SIZE - 4))
176:     {
177:       return -EBADMSG;
178:     }
179: 
180:   flags    = vp_get16(buf + VP_OFF_FLAGS);
181:   ssid_len = buf[VP_OFF_SSID_LEN];
182:   psk_len  = buf[VP_OFF_PSK_LEN];
183: 
184:   if ((flags & ~(uint16_t)VP_RECORD_FLAG_OPEN) != 0)
185:     {
186:       return -EBADMSG;
187:     }
188: 
189:   if (ssid_len == 0 || ssid_len > VELASIGHT_PROV_SSID_MAX)
190:     {
191:       return -EBADMSG;
192:     }
193: 
194:   if (psk_len != 0 &&
195:       (psk_len < VELASIGHT_PROV_PSK_MIN || psk_len > VELASIGHT_PROV_PSK_MAX))
196:     {
197:       return -EBADMSG;
198:     }
199: 
200:   if (((flags & VP_RECORD_FLAG_OPEN) != 0) != (psk_len == 0))
201:     {
202:       return -EBADMSG;
203:     }
204: 
205:   if (!vp_padding_is_zero(buf, VP_OFF_SSID, ssid_len,
206:                           VELASIGHT_PROV_SSID_MAX) ||
207:       !vp_padding_is_zero(buf, VP_OFF_PSK, psk_len,
208:                           VELASIGHT_PROV_PSK_MAX))
209:     {
210:       return -EBADMSG;
211:     }
212: 
213:   memset(&parsed, 0, sizeof(parsed));
214:   memcpy(parsed.ssid, buf + VP_OFF_SSID, ssid_len);
215:   memcpy(parsed.password, buf + VP_OFF_PSK, psk_len);
216:   parsed.generation   = vp_get32(buf + VP_OFF_GEN);
217:   parsed.open_network = psk_len == 0;
218: 
219:   /* The record can be structurally perfect and still describe credentials the
220:    * running code would refuse, for instance after a limit changes.  Treat that
221:    * as corrupt rather than handing the caller something it cannot use.
222:    */
223: 
224:   if (vp_credentials_validate(&parsed) < 0)
225:     {
226:       return -EBADMSG;
227:     }
228: 
229:   *cred = parsed;
230:   return 0;
231: }

233: static int vp_make_parent(const char *path)
234: {
235:   char dir[VP_STORE_PATH_MAX];
236:   const char *slash;
237:   size_t len;
238: 
239:   slash = strrchr(path, '/');
240:   if (slash == NULL || slash == path)
241:     {
242:       return 0;
243:     }
244: 
245:   len = (size_t)(slash - path);
246:   if (len >= sizeof(dir))
247:     {
248:       return -ENAMETOOLONG;
249:     }
250: 
251:   memcpy(dir, path, len);
252:   dir[len] = '\0';
253: 
254:   if (mkdir(dir, 0777) == 0 || errno == EEXIST)
255:     {
256:       return 0;
257:     }
258: 
259:   return -errno;
260: }

262: int vp_store_temp_path(const char *path, char *buf, size_t buflen)
263: {
264:   static const char name[] = "vpsave.tmp";
265:   const char *slash;
266:   size_t dirlen;
267: 
268:   if (path == NULL || buf == NULL)
269:     {
270:       return -EINVAL;
271:     }
272: 
273:   slash = strrchr(path, '/');
274:   dirlen = slash != NULL ? (size_t)(slash - path) + 1 : 0;
275: 
276:   if (dirlen + sizeof(name) > buflen)
277:     {
278:       return -E2BIG;
279:     }
280: 
281:   memcpy(buf, path, dirlen);
282:   memcpy(buf + dirlen, name, sizeof(name));
283:   return 0;
284: }

286: int vp_store_save(const char *path,
287:                   const struct velasight_prov_credentials_s *cred)
288: {
289:   uint8_t record[VP_RECORD_SIZE];
290:   char tmp[VP_STORE_PATH_MAX + 16];
291:   FILE *stream;
292:   int ret;
293: 
294:   if (path == NULL || cred == NULL)
295:     {
296:       return -EINVAL;
297:     }
298: 
299:   if (strlen(path) >= VP_STORE_PATH_MAX)
300:     {
301:       return -ENAMETOOLONG;
302:     }
303: 
304:   ret = vp_record_encode(record, sizeof(record), cred);
305:   if (ret < 0)
306:     {
307:       return ret;
308:     }
309: 
310:   ret = vp_make_parent(path);
311:   if (ret < 0)
312:     {
313:       return ret;
314:     }
315: 
316:   ret = vp_store_temp_path(path, tmp, sizeof(tmp));
317:   if (ret < 0)
318:     {
319:       return ret;
320:     }
321: 
322:   stream = fopen(tmp, "wb");
323:   if (stream == NULL)
324:     {
325:       return -errno;
326:     }
327: 
328:   /* Write, flush, fsync, close, rename.  Without the fsync the rename can be
329:    * durable while the data behind it is not, which on a power cut leaves a
330:    * record that passes its own CRC check by accident or fails it for no
331:    * reason the next boot can explain.
332:    */
333: 
334:   if (fwrite(record, 1, sizeof(record), stream) != sizeof(record) ||
335:       fflush(stream) != 0 || fsync(fileno(stream)) != 0)
336:     {
337:       ret = errno != 0 ? -errno : -EIO;
338:       fclose(stream);
339:       unlink(tmp);
340:       return ret;
341:     }
342: 
343:   if (fclose(stream) != 0)
344:     {
345:       ret = errno != 0 ? -errno : -EIO;
346:       unlink(tmp);
347:       return ret;
348:     }
349: 
350:   if (rename(tmp, path) < 0)
351:     {
352:       ret = -errno;
353:       unlink(tmp);
354:       return ret;
355:     }
356: 
357:   sync();
358:   return 0;
359: }

361: int vp_store_load(const char *path,
362:                   struct velasight_prov_credentials_s *cred)
363: {
364:   uint8_t record[VP_RECORD_SIZE + 1];
365:   FILE *stream;
366:   size_t nread;
367: 
368:   if (path == NULL || cred == NULL)
369:     {
370:       return -EINVAL;
371:     }
372: 
373:   stream = fopen(path, "rb");
374:   if (stream == NULL)
375:     {
376:       /* ENOTDIR belongs with ENOENT here: a directory component that is
377:        * missing, or is a file, means nothing was ever stored.  NuttX's FAT
378:        * reports ENOTDIR for the missing-directory case where Linux reports
379:        * ENOENT, and a device that has simply never been provisioned should
380:        * not look like a broken one.  EINVAL is deliberately left alone: on
381:        * that filesystem it means the configured path cannot be represented,
382:        * which is a misconfiguration worth seeing.
383:        */
384: 
385:       if (errno == ENOENT || errno == ENOTDIR)
386:         {
387:           return -ENOENT;
388:         }
389: 
390:       return -errno;
391:     }
392: 
393:   nread = fread(record, 1, sizeof(record), stream);
394:   fclose(stream);
395: 
396:   return vp_record_decode(record, nread, cred);
397: }
398: 
399: uint32_t vp_store_next_generation(const char *path)
400: {
401:   struct velasight_prov_credentials_s cred;
402: 
403:   if (vp_store_load(path, &cred) < 0 || cred.generation == UINT32_MAX)
404:     {
405:       return 1;
406:     }
407: 
408:   return cred.generation + 1;
409: }

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * app/provisioning_web/vp_form.c
3:  *
4:  * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
5:  ****************************************************************************/
6: 
7: #include <errno.h>
8: #include <stdbool.h>
9: #include <string.h>
10: 
11: #include "vp_form.h"
12: 
13: /* Long enough to tell "too long" from "just fits": the largest legal value is
14:  * a 63-byte passphrase, so a 64..126 byte submit is decoded and then rejected
15:  * on length, instead of arriving truncated to something legal.
16:  */
17: 
18: #define VP_FORM_VALUE_MAX 128
19: #define VP_FORM_NAME_MAX  32
20: 
21: static int vp_hexval(char c)
22: {
23:   if (c >= '0' && c <= '9')
24:     {
25:       return c - '0';
26:     }
27: 
28:   if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f')
29:     {
30:       return c - 'a' + 10;
31:     }
32: 
33:   if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F')
34:     {
35:       return c - 'A' + 10;
36:     }
37: 
38:   return -1;
39: }
40: 
41: int vp_url_decode(const char *src, size_t srclen, char *out, size_t outlen)
42: {
43:   size_t i = 0;
44:   size_t o = 0;
45: 
46:   if (src == NULL || out == NULL || outlen == 0)
47:     {
48:       return -EINVAL;
49:     }
50: 
51:   while (i < srclen)
52:     {
53:       unsigned char byte;
54: 
55:       if (src[i] == '%')
56:         {
57:           int hi;
58:           int lo;
59: 
60:           if (srclen - i < 3)
61:             {
62:               return -EINVAL;
63:             }
64: 
65:           hi = vp_hexval(src[i + 1]);
66:           lo = vp_hexval(src[i + 2]);
67:           if (hi < 0 || lo < 0)
68:             {
69:               return -EINVAL;
70:             }
71: 
72:           byte = (unsigned char)((hi << 4) | lo);
73:           i += 3;
74:         }
75:       else if (src[i] == '+')
76:         {
77:           byte = (unsigned char)' ';
78:           i++;
79:         }
80:       else
81:         {
82:           byte = (unsigned char)src[i];
83:           i++;
84:         }
85: 
86:       /* %00 would otherwise cut the value short and leave the rest of it
87:        * unexamined, which is how a validated string stops matching the bytes
88:        * that were actually submitted.
89:        */
90: 
91:       if (byte == 0)
92:         {
93:           return -EINVAL;
94:         }
95: 
96:       if (o + 1 >= outlen)
97:         {
98:           return -E2BIG;
99:         }
100: 
101:       out[o++] = (char)byte;
102:     }
103: 
104:   out[o] = '\0';
105:   return (int)o;
106: }
107: 
108: static size_t vp_strnlen(const char *s, size_t maxlen)
109: {
110:   size_t n = 0;
111: 
112:   while (n < maxlen && s[n] != '\0')
113:     {
114:       n++;
115:     }
116: 
117:   return n;
118: }
119: 
120: static bool vp_ssid_char_ok(char c)
121: {
122:   unsigned char u = (unsigned char)c;
123: 
124:   /* Control characters only: an SSID is arbitrary bytes on the air, and a
125:    * UTF-8 name has to survive.
126:    */
127: 
128:   return u >= 0x20 && u != 0x7f;
129: }
130: 
131: static bool vp_psk_char_ok(char c)
132: {
133:   unsigned char u = (unsigned char)c;
134: 
135:   /* A WPA2 passphrase is printable ASCII.  Anything else could not have been
136:    * typed into the router either.
137:    */
138: 
139:   return u >= 0x20 && u <= 0x7e;
140: }

142: int vp_credentials_validate(
143:     const struct velasight_prov_credentials_s *cred)
144: {
145:   size_t len;
146:   size_t i;
147: 
148:   if (cred == NULL)
149:     {
150:       return -EINVAL;
151:     }
152: 
153:   len = vp_strnlen(cred->ssid, sizeof(cred->ssid));
154:   if (len == 0 || len > VELASIGHT_PROV_SSID_MAX)
155:     {
156:       return -EINVAL;
157:     }
158: 
159:   for (i = 0; i < len; i++)
160:     {
161:       if (!vp_ssid_char_ok(cred->ssid[i]))
162:         {
163:           return -EINVAL;
164:         }
165:     }
166: 
167:   len = vp_strnlen(cred->password, sizeof(cred->password));
168:   if (len == 0)
169:     {
170:       /* The flag and the passphrase have to tell the same story, otherwise a
171:        * caller that trusts only one of them behaves differently from a caller
172:        * that trusts the other.
173:        */
174: 
175:       return cred->open_network ? 0 : -EINVAL;
176:     }
177: 
178:   if (cred->open_network)
179:     {
180:       return -EINVAL;
181:     }
182: 
183:   if (len < VELASIGHT_PROV_PSK_MIN || len > VELASIGHT_PROV_PSK_MAX)
184:     {
185:       return -EINVAL;
186:     }
187: 
188:   for (i = 0; i < len; i++)
189:     {
190:       if (!vp_psk_char_ok(cred->password[i]))
191:         {
192:           return -EINVAL;
193:         }
194:     }
195: 
196:   return 0;
197: }

199: int vp_form_parse(const char *body, size_t bodylen,
200:                   struct velasight_prov_credentials_s *cred)
201: {
202:   uint32_t generation;
203:   unsigned nfields = 0;
204:   bool have_ssid = false;
205:   bool have_psk = false;
206:   size_t pos = 0;
207: 
208:   if (body == NULL || cred == NULL)
209:     {
210:       return -EINVAL;
211:     }
212: 
213:   generation = cred->generation;
214:   memset(cred, 0, sizeof(*cred));
215:   cred->generation = generation;
216: 
217:   while (pos < bodylen)
218:     {
219:       char name[VP_FORM_NAME_MAX + 1];
220:       char value[VP_FORM_VALUE_MAX];
221:       const char *sep;
222:       const char *amp;
223:       size_t fieldlen;
224:       size_t namelen;
225:       int decoded;
226: 
227:       amp = memchr(body + pos, '&', bodylen - pos);
228:       fieldlen = amp != NULL ? (size_t)(amp - (body + pos)) : bodylen - pos;
229: 
230:       if (++nfields > VP_FORM_MAX_FIELDS)
231:         {
232:           return -E2BIG;
233:         }
234: 
235:       if (fieldlen == 0)
236:         {
237:           pos += 1;
238:           continue;
239:         }
240: 
241:       sep = memchr(body + pos, '=', fieldlen);
242:       if (sep == NULL)
243:         {
244:           /* "ssid" without a value is not an empty SSID, it is a body this
245:            * code does not understand.
246:            */
247: 
248:           return -EINVAL;
249:         }
250: 
251:       namelen = (size_t)(sep - (body + pos));
252:       decoded = vp_url_decode(body + pos, namelen, name, sizeof(name));
253:       if (decoded == -EINVAL)
254:         {
255:           return -EINVAL;
256:         }
257: 
258:       if (decoded < 0)
259:         {
260:           /* A name too long to be one of ours cannot be one of ours. */
261: 
262:           goto next;
263:         }
264: 
265:       if (strcmp(name, "ssid") != 0 && strcmp(name, "password") != 0)
266:         {
267:           goto next;
268:         }
269: 
270:       decoded = vp_url_decode(sep + 1, fieldlen - namelen - 1,
271:                               value, sizeof(value));
272:       if (decoded < 0)
273:         {
274:           return -EINVAL;
275:         }
276:

3:  *

5:  * hand on a board that has been switched into SoftAP.  Applications should
6:  * call velasight_provisioning_start() from their own long-lived task instead:
7:  * the listener runs on a pthread, and a pthread does not outlive the task that
8:  * created it, so a command that started the service and returned would take
9:  * the service with it.  That is why this command stays in the foreground.
10:  *
11:  * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
12:  ****************************************************************************/
13: 
14: #include <arpa/inet.h>
15: #include <errno.h>
16: #include <netinet/in.h>

23: #include <sys/time.h>
24: #include <unistd.h>

26: #include "velasight_provisioning.h"
27: 
28: static volatile bool g_interrupted;
29: 
30: static void provision_usage(void)
31: {
32:   printf("usage: provision_web [run [port] [--one-shot]] | selftest | show |"
33:          " path\n"
34:          "\n"
35:          "  run       serve the provisioning page until Ctrl-C.  port\n"
36:          "            defaults to %d.  --one-shot returns after the first\n"
37:          "            accepted save.\n"
38:          "  selftest  submit a canned form over loopback and verify it was\n"
39:          "            persisted.  Overwrites the stored record with a test\n"
40:          "            network; needs no phone.\n"
41:          "  show      print the stored network, never the passphrase\n"
42:          "  path      print the store path\n"
43:          "\n"
44:          "This service never changes the Wi-Fi role.  Put the board into\n"
45:          "SoftAP first (see docs/WiFi使用说明.md) and switch back afterwards.\n"
46:          "The page is plain HTTP with no authentication, so run it only while\n"
47:          "provisioning.\n",
48:          CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_PORT);
49: }
50: 
51: static void provision_on_signal(int signo)
52: {
53:   (void)signo;
54:   g_interrupted = true;
55: }
56: 
57: static void provision_on_saved(int status, uint32_t generation, void *arg)
58: {
59:   (void)arg;
60: 
61:   if (status < 0)
62:     {
63:       printf("provision_web: save failed: %d\n", status);
64:       return;
65:     }
66: 
67:   printf("provision_web: credentials saved, generation %u\n",
68:          (unsigned)generation);
69: }
70: 
71: static int provision_show(void)
72: {
73:   struct velasight_prov_credentials_s cred;
74:   int ret;
75: 
76:   ret = velasight_provisioning_load(&cred);
77:   if (ret == -ENOENT)
78:     {
79:       printf("provision_web: nothing provisioned at %s\n",
80:              CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_STORE);
81:       return EXIT_FAILURE;
82:     }
83: 
84:   if (ret < 0)
85:     {
86:       printf("provision_web: cannot read %s: %d\n",
87:              CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_STORE, ret);
88:       return EXIT_FAILURE;
89:     }
90: 
91:   /* Deliberately only whether a passphrase exists.  Printing it would put it
92:    * into the serial log, which is the one place it is guaranteed to be read by
93:    * someone who did not need it.
94:    */
95: 
96:   printf("provision_web: ssid=%s security=%s password=%s generation=%u\n",
97:          cred.ssid, cred.open_network ? "open" : "wpa2",
98:          cred.open_network ? "none" : "set",
99:          (unsigned)cred.generation);

103: static int provision_run(int argc, char *argv[])
104: {
105:   struct velasight_prov_config_s cfg;
106:   struct sigaction sa;
107:   int i;
108:   int ret;
109: 
110:   memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
111:   cfg.on_saved = provision_on_saved;
112: 
113:   for (i = 2; i < argc; i++)
114:     {
115:       if (strcmp(argv[i], "--one-shot") == 0)
116:         {
117:           cfg.one_shot = true;
118:         }
119:       else

123:           if (port <= 0 || port > 65535)

127:             }

129:           cfg.port = (uint16_t)port;
130:         }
131:     }
132: 
133:   memset(&sa, 0, sizeof(sa));
134:   sa.sa_handler = provision_on_signal;
135:   sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);

137:   ret = velasight_provisioning_start(&cfg);

140:       printf("provision_web: start failed: %d\n", ret);

148:     {
149:       usleep(200000);
150:     }
151: 
152:   velasight_provisioning_stop();
153:   printf("provision_web: stopped after %u save(s)\n",
154:          (unsigned)velasight_provisioning_generation());
155:   return EXIT_SUCCESS;
156: }

159:  * Name: provision_selftest

161:  * Description:
162:  *   Drive the service over loopback on the board itself.  The host tests
163:  *   already cover the parsing and the record; what only the board can answer
164:  *   is whether this network stack accepts the listener and whether the SD-NAND
165:  *   write really lands.  Needs no phone, which matters because a Wi-Fi client
166:  *   is not always available when the firmware is.
167:  *
168:  *   It overwrites the stored record with an obvious test network.  The
169:  *   passphrase below is a fixed test string, never a real one.
170:  *
171:  ****************************************************************************/
172: 
173: #define PROV_TEST_PORT 18080
174: #define PROV_TEST_SSID "VelaSightProvTest"
175: #define PROV_TEST_PSK  "selftest-pass"

178: static int g_selftest_failures;
179: static volatile int g_selftest_cb_status = 1;

183: {
184:   g_selftest_checks++;
185:   if (!ok)
186:     {
187:       g_selftest_failures++;
188:     }
189:

194:                                      void *arg)

201: static int provision_exchange(const char *request, char *reply,
202:                               size_t replylen)
203: {
204:   struct sockaddr_in addr;
205:   struct timeval tv;
206:   size_t total = 0;
207:   int fd;
208: 
209:   fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
210:   if (fd < 0)
211:     {
212:       return -errno;
213:     }
214: 
215:   tv.tv_sec  = 5;
216:   tv.tv_usec = 0;
217:   setsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVTIMEO, &tv, sizeof(tv));
218:   setsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDTIMEO, &tv, sizeof(tv));
219: 
220:   memset(&addr, 0, sizeof(addr));
221:   addr.sin_family      = AF_INET;
222:   addr.sin_port        = htons(PROV_TEST_PORT);
223:   addr.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);
224: 
225:   if (connect(fd, (struct sockaddr *)&addr, sizeof(addr)) < 0)
226:     {
227:       int error = -errno;
228: 
229:       close(fd);
230:       return error;
231:     }
232: 
233:   if (write(fd, request, strlen(request)) < 0)
234:     {
235:       int error = -errno;
236: 
237:       close(fd);
238:       return error;
239:     }
240: 
241:   for (; ; )
242:     {
243:       ssize_t n = read(fd, reply + total, replylen - 1 - total);
244: 
245:       if (n <= 0)
246:         {
247:           break;
248:         }
249: 
250:       total += (size_t)n;
251:       if (total >= replylen - 1)
252:         {
253:           break;
254:         }
255:     }
256: 
257:   close(fd);
258:   reply[total] = '\0';
259:   return (int)total;

1: # AP 模式简易配网 Web
2: 
3: 板子进入 SoftAP 后调用一个入口，手机连上热点打开网页填 SSID 和密码，凭据原子写入
4: SD-NAND，应用通过回调知道「第 N 次保存成功」。
5: 
6: **本服务不切换 Wi-Fi 模式。** 不调用 `wapi`、不 `ifup/ifdown`、不关联、不启停 DHCPD。
7: 进 SoftAP 和切回 STA 全部由应用或人工完成——只有应用知道什么时候可以让网络断开。
8: 
9: ## 应用侧用法
10: 
11: ```c
12: #include "velasight_provisioning.h"
13: 
14: static void on_saved(int status, uint32_t generation, void *arg)
15: {
16:   if (status < 0)
17:     {
18:       /* 写盘失败，凭据没存下来 */
19:       return;
20:     }
21: 
22:   /* 页面已经发完、连接已经关闭，这里可以安全地切回 STA */
23:   struct velasight_prov_credentials_s cred;
24: 
25:   if (velasight_provisioning_load(&cred) == 0)
26:     {
27:       /* cred.ssid / cred.password / cred.open_network */
28:       velasight_provisioning_stop();   /* 从回调里调用是安全的 */
29:       /* 这里做你自己的 STA 切换与关联 */
30:     }
31: }
32: 
33: struct velasight_prov_config_s cfg =
34: {
35:   .port       = 0,          /* 0 → 80 */
36:   .one_shot   = false,      /* true = 成功保存一次后自动停止 */
37:   .store_path = NULL,       /* NULL → CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_STORE */
38:   .on_saved   = on_saved,
39:   .cb_arg     = NULL,
40: };
41: 
42: velasight_provisioning_start(&cfg);
43: ```
44: 
45: | 函数 | 说明 |
46: |---|---|
47: | `velasight_provisioning_start(cfg)` | 绑定端口并启动监听线程。已在运行返回 `-EALREADY`；`cfg` 可为 NULL 表示全默认 |
48: | `velasight_provisioning_stop()` | 关闭监听并回收线程。未运行返回 `-EALREADY`。可在回调里调用 |
49: | `velasight_provisioning_is_running()` | 是否在监听 |
50: | `velasight_provisioning_generation()` | 本次运行内成功保存的次数，未保存过为 0 |
51: | `velasight_provisioning_load(out)` | 读取凭据。`-ENOENT` 未配网，`-EBADMSG` 记录损坏 |
52: | `velasight_provisioning_load_from(path, out)` | 指定路径读取 |
53: 
54: 回调只带状态码和序号，不带凭据：要凭据请显式 `load()`，这样密码不会顺着每一个只想收
55: 通知的回调链路走一遍。回调固定在**响应发完并关闭连接之后**触发——反过来会在应用切走
56: Wi-Fi 时截断响应，手机上看到的是「提交失败」而实际已经存了。
57: 
58: 监听线程是 pthread，pthread 不会比创建它的任务活得更久，所以应用要在自己的长驻任务里
59: 调 `start()`。
60: 
61: ## 手工上板验证
62: 
63: 先切 SoftAP（详见 `docs/WiFi使用说明.md`）：
64: 
65: ```sh
66: ifdown wlan0
67: ifup wlan0
68: wapi mode wlan0 3
69: wapi freq wlan0 6 1
70: wapi psk wlan0 <8-63字节密码> 3
71: wapi essid wlan0 VelaSight_AP 1
72: dhcpd_start wlan0            # 板子成为 192.168.10.1
73: ```
74: 
75: 再起配网页面：
76: 
77: ```sh
78: provision_web run            # 前台运行，Ctrl-C 停止
79: provision_web run 8080       # 换端口
80: provision_web run --one-shot # 成功保存一次后返回
81: ```
82: 
83: 手机连上 `VelaSight_AP` 后浏览器打开 `http://192.168.10.1/`，填 SSID 和密码提交。
84: 
85: 查看已存内容（**不打印密码**）：
86: 
87: ```sh
88: provision_web show
89: # provision_web: ssid=AIPC security=wpa2 password=set generation=1
90: provision_web path
91: # /mnt/sdnand/prov/wifi.bin
92: ```
93: 
94: 没有手机或 Wi-Fi 客户端时，用板子自己的回环把整条链路走一遍（会用测试网络覆盖已存
95: 记录，不需要进 SoftAP）：
96: 
97: ```sh
98: provision_web selftest
99: # provision_web selftest: PASS, 14 checks, 0 failures
100: reboot
101: provision_web show      # 证明记录跨重启存活
102: ```
103: 
104: 验完切回 STA，仍然按 `docs/WiFi使用说明.md`：
105: 
106: ```sh
107: dhcpd_stop
108: ifdown wlan0
109: ifup wlan0
110: wapi mode wlan0 2
111: wapi psk wlan0 <路由器密码> 3
112: wapi essid wlan0 <2.4G_SSID> 1
113: renew wlan0
114: ```
115: 
116: ## HTTP 表面
117: 
118: | 请求 | 响应 |
119: |---|---|
120: | `GET /`、`GET /index.html` | 200 表单页 |
121: | `POST /save`（`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`） | 200 成功页 / 400 校验失败 / 500 写盘失败 |
122: | 其他方法 | 405 |
123: | 其他路径 | 404 |
124: | 缺 `Content-Length` | 411 |
125: | body > 512 字节 | 413 |
126: | 非表单 Content-Type | 415 |
127: | 请求头 > 2048 字节 | 431 |
128: | `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` | 400 |
129: 
130: 读超时 5 秒，一次只服务一个连接，每个连接答完即关闭。成功页只回显经过 HTML 转义的
131: SSID；**密码永不回显、永不进日志**。
132: 
133: 校验规则：SSID 1–32 字节且不含控制字符；密码留空表示开放网络，否则必须 8–63 字节的
134: 可打印 ASCII。表单缺 `ssid` 直接 400；`ssid` 或 `password` 重复出现按歧义拒绝，不猜。
135: 
136: ## NAND 记录
137: 
138: 默认 `/mnt/sdnand/prov/wifi.bin`，固定 114 字节，小端：
139: 
140: | 偏移 | 长度 | 字段 |
141: |---|---|---|
142: | 0 | 4 | 魔数 `VSWP` |
143: | 4 | 2 | 版本，当前 1 |
144: | 6 | 2 | 标志位，bit0 = 开放网络 |
145: | 8 | 4 | generation |
146: | 12 | 1 | ssid_len，1..32 |
147: | 13 | 1 | psk_len，0 或 8..63 |
148: | 14 | 32 | SSID，补零 |
149: | 46 | 63 | 密码，补零 |
150: | 109 | 1 | 保留，必须 0 |
151: | 110 | 4 | CRC32（IEEE，覆盖 0..109） |
152: 
153: 落盘顺序是同目录的 `vpsave.tmp` → `fflush` → `fsync` → `close` → `rename` → `sync()`。
154: 魔数、版本、两个长度、开放标志与 `psk_len` 的自洽性、补零区、保留字节和 CRC 逐项校验，
155: 任何一项不过按 `-EBADMSG` 处理，不做「尽力恢复」。
156: 
157: 只保留最新一份，提交即替换，generation 递增。凭据不镜像到 kvdb——需要的话由应用读出后
158: 自己写。
159: 
160: ## 三条平台约束（都是上板实测撞出来的）
161: 
162: 改动这三处之前先读这一节，否则会重现同样的故障：
163: 
164: 1. **`/mnt` 必须保持伪文件系统。** PSRAM ramdisk 挂在 `/mnt/ram`，不是 `/mnt`。
165:    NuttX 不允许在真实文件系统内部再挂载，`/mnt` 上挂了 littlefs 之后 SD-NAND 的
166:    `/mnt/sdnand` 会以 `-ENOTDIR` 挂载失败，持久存储静默消失。
167: 2. **`CONFIG_NET_TCPBACKLOG=y` 是必需项。** 没有它 listening socket 上不会有
168:    `POLLIN`，`accept()` 也无超时，可停止的监听线程无法实现；症状是打印了 listening
169:    之后什么都不回。本模块 Kconfig 已 `depends on` 它，配置错误会在编译期暴露。
170: 3. **SD-NAND 是不带长名的 VFAT。** `CONFIG_FAT_LFN` 未开，路径每一段必须符合 8.3。
171:    `velasight/`、`wifi-provision.bin` 都会被 `-EINVAL` 拒绝，把 `.tmp` 追加到
172:    `wifi.bin` 得到两个点也非法——所以临时文件是固定名 `vpsave.tmp`。主机测试会逐段
173:    校验默认路径的 8.3 合规性。
174: 
175: VFAT 上 `rename` 不是单步原子：NuttX 的 VFS 先 unlink 目标，FAT 的 `rename` 拒绝覆盖。
176: 所以存在「旧记录已删、新记录未就位」的极短窗口，此时读到 `-ENOENT`；读不到截断记录，
177: 因为长度和 CRC 都会拒绝。
178: 
179: ## 安全边界
180: 
181: - **服务是明文 HTTP 且无鉴权。** 热点覆盖内的任何设备都能提交。缓解手段：SoftAP 带
182:   WPA2 密码、只在配网期间开启、配完 `stop()`，或者用 `one_shot`。
183: - **密码在 NAND 上是明文。** VFAT 没有可信的权限模型，这颗芯片也没有已确认可用的设备

2:  * app/provisioning_web/vp_store.h
3:  *
4:  * The persisted record and its atomic replacement.  Fixed size, versioned,
5:  * length-checked and CRC-protected, because a half-written credential file on
6:  * a VFAT volume that loses power mid-write is otherwise indistinguishable
7:  * from a valid one.
8:  *
9:  * The passphrase is stored in the clear.  VFAT has no permission model worth
10:  * relying on and this chip has no confirmed device key, so pretending to
11:  * encrypt would only hide the exposure.  What is controlled instead: it is
12:  * never logged, never echoed back over HTTP, and only read through the public
13:  * API.  Physical access to the SD-NAND reveals it.
14:  *
15:  * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
16:  ****************************************************************************/
17: 
18: #ifndef __APP_PROVISIONING_WEB_VP_STORE_H
19: #define __APP_PROVISIONING_WEB_VP_STORE_H
20: 
21: #include <stddef.h>
22: #include <stdint.h>
23: 
24: #include "velasight_provisioning.h"
25: 
26: /* Layout, little-endian:
27:  *
28:  *   0   4   magic "VSWP"
29:  *   4   2   version, currently 1
30:  *   6   2   flags, bit0 = open network
31:  *   8   4   generation
32:  *   12  1   ssid_len, 1..32
33:  *   13  1   psk_len, 0 or 8..63
34:  *   14  32  ssid, zero padded
35:  *   46  63  password, zero padded
36:  *   109 1   reserved, must be zero
37:  *   110 4   CRC32 of bytes 0..109
38:  */
39: 
40: #define VP_RECORD_SIZE    114
41: #define VP_RECORD_VERSION 1
42: #define VP_RECORD_MAGIC   "VSWP"
43: 
44: #define VP_RECORD_FLAG_OPEN 0x0001u
45: 
46: uint32_t vp_crc32(const void *data, size_t len);
47: 
48: /****************************************************************************
49:  * Name: vp_record_encode / vp_record_decode
50:  *
51:  * Description:
52:  *   Serialize and parse the record.  encode returns VP_RECORD_SIZE, -EINVAL
53:  *   for credentials that do not validate, or -E2BIG for a short buffer.
54:  *   decode returns 0 or -EBADMSG; it checks the magic, the version, both
55:  *   lengths, that the open flag agrees with psk_len, the reserved byte and
56:  *   the CRC.  A record that fails any of those is corrupt, not repairable.
57:  *
58:  ****************************************************************************/
59:

61:                      const struct velasight_prov_credentials_s *cred);
62:

64:                      struct velasight_prov_credentials_s *cred);
65:

68:  *
69:  * Description:
70:  *   The scratch file used by vp_store_save(), placed beside the record.
71:  *
72:  *   It is a fixed name rather than "<path>.tmp" because the SD-NAND is VFAT
73:  *   without long-name support: "wifi.bin.tmp" has two dots and every
74:  *   component must fit 8.3, so the obvious derivation is rejected with
75:  *   -EINVAL by the filesystem.  One save runs at a time, so a fixed name
76:  *   costs nothing.

99:  *

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/src/bk7258_wifi_config.c
3:  *
4:  * Apply the stored Wi-Fi credentials, so the board joins its network after a
5:  * reset without anyone typing `wapi`.
6:  *
7:  * The store held wifi.ssid and wifi.psk from the start and nothing read them:
8:  * the keys were defined, documented and masked in `kvdb list`, and the actual
9:  * association was still the manual sequence from docs/WiFi使用说明.md.  This
10:  * file is the missing consumer, and it does exactly what those two `wapi`
11:  * commands do, through the same ioctls:
12:  *
13:  *   wapi psk wlan0 <passphrase> 3  ->  SIOCSIWENCODEEXT
14:  *   wapi essid wlan0 <ssid> 1      ->  SIOCSIWESSID with IW_ESSID_ON, which
15:  *                                      the upper half turns into essid(set)
16:  *                                      followed by connect()
17:  *                                      (netdev_upperhalf.c)
18:  *
19:  * What it deliberately does not do is DHCP.  There is no DHCP client on this
20:  * side of the build -- dhcpc lives in apps -- so an address still comes from
21:  * `renew wlan0`, which this configuration already ships.  Association is the
22:  * part that needed a human and a password; asking for an address does not.
23:  *
24:  * Called from the kvdb_loader task, never from bring-up: the association
25:  * request crosses to the CP and blocks, and bring-up must not block or the
26:  * mailbox stops being serviced (see bk7258_kvdb_init()).
27:  *
28:  * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
29:  ****************************************************************************/
30: 
31: /****************************************************************************
32:  * Included Files
33:  ****************************************************************************/
34: 
35: #include <nuttx/config.h>
36: 
37: #include <errno.h>
38: #include <stdio.h>
39: #include <string.h>
40: #include <unistd.h>
41: 
42: #include <sys/ioctl.h>
43: #include <sys/socket.h>
44: 
45: #include <net/if.h>
46: #include <netinet/in.h>
47: 
48: #include <nuttx/wireless/wireless.h>
49: 
50: #include "bk7258_kvdb.h"
51: 
52: /****************************************************************************
53:  * Pre-processor Definitions
54:  ****************************************************************************/
55: 
56: #define WIFI_IFNAME       "wlan0"
57: 
58: /* The driver's own limits (bk7258_wifi.c g_wifi.ssid / g_wifi.password): a
59:  * 32-character SSID and a 64-character passphrase, each plus a terminator.
60:  */
61: 
62: #define WIFI_SSID_MAX     33
63: #define WIFI_PSK_MAX      65
64: 
65: /****************************************************************************
66:  * Private Functions
67:  ****************************************************************************/
68: 
69: static int wifi_config_ifup(int sock)
70: {
71:   struct ifreq ifr;
72:   int ret;
73: 
74:   memset(&ifr, 0, sizeof(ifr));
75:   strlcpy(ifr.ifr_name, WIFI_IFNAME, IFNAMSIZ);
76: 
77:   ret = ioctl(sock, SIOCGIFFLAGS, (unsigned long)&ifr);
78:   if (ret < 0)
79:     {
80:       return -errno;
81:     }
82: 
83:   if ((ifr.ifr_flags & IFF_UP) != 0)
84:     {
85:       return OK;
86:     }
87: 
88:   ifr.ifr_flags |= IFF_UP;
89: 
90:   ret = ioctl(sock, SIOCSIFFLAGS, (unsigned long)&ifr);
91:   return ret < 0 ? -errno : OK;
92: }
93: 
94: static int wifi_config_passphrase(int sock, FAR const char *psk)
95: {
96:   /* The key follows the descriptor, which is why this is a byte buffer and
97:    * not just a struct: iw_encode_ext ends in key[0].
98:    */
99: 
100:   uint8_t buffer[sizeof(struct iw_encode_ext) + WIFI_PSK_MAX];
101:   FAR struct iw_encode_ext *ext = (FAR struct iw_encode_ext *)buffer;
102:   struct iwreq req;
103:   size_t len = strlen(psk);
104:   int ret;
105: 
106:   memset(buffer, 0, sizeof(buffer));
107:   memset(&req, 0, sizeof(req));
108: 
109:   ext->alg = IW_ENCODE_ALG_CCMP;
110:   ext->key_len = (uint16_t)len;
111:   memcpy(ext->key, psk, len);
112: 
113:   strlcpy(req.ifr_name, WIFI_IFNAME, IFNAMSIZ);
114:   req.u.encoding.pointer = ext;
115:   req.u.encoding.length = sizeof(struct iw_encode_ext) + len;
116:   req.u.encoding.flags = IW_ENCODE_ALG_CCMP;
117: 
118:   ret = ioctl(sock, SIOCSIWENCODEEXT, (unsigned long)&req);
119:   return ret < 0 ? -errno : OK;
120: }
121: 
122: static int wifi_config_associate(int sock, FAR const char *ssid)
123: {
124:   struct iwreq req;
125:   int ret;
126: 
127:   memset(&req, 0, sizeof(req));
128:   strlcpy(req.ifr_name, WIFI_IFNAME, IFNAMSIZ);
129:   req.u.essid.pointer = (FAR void *)ssid;
130:   req.u.essid.length = strlen(ssid);
131:   req.u.essid.flags = IW_ESSID_ON;
132: 
133:   ret = ioctl(sock, SIOCSIWESSID, (unsigned long)&req);
134:   return ret < 0 ? -errno : OK;
135: }
136: 
137: /****************************************************************************
138:  * Public Functions
139:  ****************************************************************************/
140: 
141: int bk7258_kvdb_apply_wifi(void)
142: {
143:   char ssid[WIFI_SSID_MAX];
144:   char psk[WIFI_PSK_MAX];
145:   int sock;
146:   int ret;
147: 
148:   ret = bk7258_kvdb_get(BK7258_KVDB_KEY_WIFI_SSID, ssid, sizeof(ssid));
149:   if (ret <= 0)
150:     {
151:       /* Nothing stored, or stored empty.  Not a failure: the board simply has
152:        * no network configured yet and `wapi` still works.
153:        */
154: 
155:       return -ENOENT;
156:     }
157: 
158:   if (bk7258_kvdb_get(BK7258_KVDB_KEY_WIFI_PSK, psk, sizeof(psk)) <= 0)
159:     {
160:       psk[0] = '\0';           /* Open network */
161:     }
162: 
163:   sock = socket(PF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, 0);
164:   if (sock < 0)
165:     {
166:       return -errno;
167:     }
168: 
169:   ret = wifi_config_ifup(sock);
170:   if (ret < 0)
171:     {
172:       printf("kvdb: wlan0 would not come up (%d), Wi-Fi not configured\n",
173:              ret);
174:       goto out;
175:     }
176: 
177:   if (psk[0] != '\0')
178:     {
179:       ret = wifi_config_passphrase(sock, psk);
180:       if (ret < 0)
181:         {
182:           printf("kvdb: passphrase rejected (%d), Wi-Fi not configured\n",
183:                  ret);
184:           goto out;
185:         }
186:     }
187: 
188:   ret = wifi_config_associate(sock, ssid);
189:   if (ret < 0)
190:     {
191:       printf("kvdb: could not associate with %s (%d)\n", ssid, ret);
192:       goto out;
193:     }
194: 
195:   /* The SSID is not a secret and naming it is what makes this line useful; the
196:    * passphrase is never printed, only whether there was one.
197:    */
198: 
199:   printf("kvdb: associating with %s (%s) -- run `renew wlan0` for an "
200:          "address\n", ssid, psk[0] != '\0' ? "WPA2" : "open");
201: 
202: out:
203:   close(sock);
204:   return ret;
205: }
