1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/src/bk7258_net_autostart.c
3:  *
4:  * Bring the network up at boot and, if it is built in, start the development
5:  * console service.
6:  *
7:  * Why this is board code and not part of app/web_tool: joining the stored
8:  * network is what this board should do when it is switched on, whether or not
9:  * any particular application happens to be compiled into the image.  Putting
10:  * it inside web_tool would make "does the board get on the network" depend on
11:  * a Kconfig symbol for a debug tool, and the next configuration that leaves
12:  * that tool out would silently lose its network too.
13:  *
14:  * The pieces this needs are split across the two halves of the system, so it
15:  * uses each from where it lives instead of duplicating either:
16:  *
17:  *   association  bk7258_kvdb_apply_wifi(), board side -- the two `wapi`
18:  *                commands through the same ioctls
19:  *   DHCP         the `renew` builtin, application side.  There is no DHCP
20:  *                client on the kernel side of this build; dhcpc lives in
21:  *                apps.  Rather than reach across that line with a hand-written
22:  *                include path, this looks the command up in the builtin table
23:  *                (builtin_isavail/builtin_for_index, both kernel-visible) and
24:  *                starts it as a task.  Missing means "not compiled in", which
25:  *                is reported and skipped, not fatal.
26:  *
27:  * The retry around DHCP is not defensive padding: the first request after
28:  * association is measured to fail -- there is a window between "associated"
29:  * and "can exchange DHCP" -- and a boot script that took the first failure as
30:  * the answer would report a working network as broken every time.
31:  *
32:  * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
33:  ****************************************************************************/
34: 
35: /****************************************************************************
36:  * Included Files
37:  ****************************************************************************/
38: 
39: #include <nuttx/config.h>
40: 
41: #include <errno.h>
42: #include <sched.h>
43: #include <stdbool.h>
44: #include <stdio.h>
45: #include <string.h>
46: #include <unistd.h>
47: 
48: #include <sys/wait.h>
49: 
50: #include <net/if.h>
51: 
52: #include <nuttx/lib/builtin.h>
53: 
54: #include "bk7258_kvdb.h"
55: 
56: /****************************************************************************
57:  * Pre-processor Definitions
58:  ****************************************************************************/
59: 
60: #define NET_IFNAME        "wlan0"
61: 
62: /* How many times to ask for an address, and how long to wait between tries.
63:  * Two attempts is what the measured failure needs; more would only lengthen
64:  * a boot that has no network to find.
65:  */
66: 
67: #define NET_DHCP_TRIES    3
68: #define NET_DHCP_GAP_MS   1500
69: 
70: /****************************************************************************
71:  * Private Functions
72:  ****************************************************************************/
73: 
74: /****************************************************************************
75:  * Name: net_spawn_builtin
76:  *
77:  * Description:
78:  *   Start a builtin application by name, using the registration the build
79:  *   already produced (priority, stack size and entry point), and optionally
80:  *   wait for it.  Returns the exit status when waiting, 0 when not, or a
81:  *   negative value when the application is not in this image.
82:  *
83:  ****************************************************************************/
84: 
85: static int net_spawn_builtin(FAR const char *name, FAR char * const *argv,
86:                              bool wait)
87: {
88:   FAR const struct builtin_s *entry;
89:   int index;
90:   int pid;
91:   int status = 0;
92: 
93:   index = builtin_isavail(name);
94:   if (index < 0)
95:     {
96:       return index;
97:     }
98: 
99:   entry = builtin_for_index(index);
100:   if (entry == NULL)
101:     {
102:       return -ENOENT;
103:     }
104: 
105:   pid = task_create(entry->name, entry->priority, entry->stacksize,
106:                     entry->main, argv);
107:   if (pid < 0)
108:     {
109:       return pid;
110:     }
111: 
112:   if (wait)
113:     {
114:       if (waitpid(pid, &status, 0) < 0)
115:         {
116:           return -errno;
117:         }
118:     }
119: 
120:   return status;
121: }
122: 
123: /****************************************************************************
124:  * Public Functions
125:  ****************************************************************************/
126: 
127: /****************************************************************************
128:  * Name: bk7258_net_autostart
129:  *
130:  * Description:
131:  *   Join the stored network and start the console service.
132:  *
133:  *   Must be called from a task and never from bring-up: association blocks on
134:  *   the CP and DHCP blocks on the network, and an AP that stops servicing the
135:  *   mailbox loses the heartbeat, after which the CP's 8-second watchdog resets
136:  *   the chip.  That is the same constraint that made kvdb_loader a task, so
137:  *   this is called from the end of it -- which also guarantees the credentials
138:  *   have already come back from flash.
139:  *
140:  ****************************************************************************/
141: 
142: void bk7258_net_autostart(void)
143: {
144:   FAR char *renew_argv[3];
145:   int tries;
146:   int ret;
147: 
148:   /* Association, from the credentials in the store.  -ENOENT means nobody has
149:    * configured a network yet, which is an ordinary state for a fresh board and
150:    * not worth a scary message.
151:    */
152: 
153:   ret = bk7258_kvdb_apply_wifi();
154:   if (ret == -ENOENT)
155:     {
156:       printf("net: no wifi.ssid stored; run `kvdb set wifi.ssid ...`\n");
157:       return;
158:     }
159: 
160:   if (ret < 0)
161:     {
162:       printf("net: association failed (%d); Wi-Fi not configured\n", ret);
163:       return;
164:     }
165: 
166:   renew_argv[0] = (FAR char *)"renew";
167:   renew_argv[1] = (FAR char *)NET_IFNAME;
168:   renew_argv[2] = NULL;
169: 
170:   for (tries = 0; tries < NET_DHCP_TRIES; tries++)
171:     {
172:       usleep(NET_DHCP_GAP_MS * 1000);
173: 
174:       ret = net_spawn_builtin("renew", renew_argv, true);
175:       if (ret < 0)
176:         {
177:           printf("net: `renew` is not in this image (%d); ask for an "
178:                  "address by hand\n", ret);
179:           break;
180:         }
181: 
182:       if (ret == 0)
183:         {
184:           printf("net: address obtained on attempt %d\n", tries + 1);
185:           break;
186:         }
187: 
188:       /* Not an error yet.  The first attempt after association is expected to
189:        * fail; saying which attempt succeeded is more useful than hiding the
190:        * retry.
191:        */
192: 
193:       printf("net: DHCP attempt %d did not get an address, retrying\n",
194:              tries + 1);
195:     }
196: 
197:   /* The console service, if it was built in.  It refuses to listen unless
198:    * web.allow is set, and says so on the console, so starting it
199:    * unconditionally cannot open the board up by itself.
200:    */
201: 
202:   ret = net_spawn_builtin("web_tool", NULL, false);
203:   if (ret < 0)
204:     {
205:       /* Not built in, or could not start.  Neither is fatal: the board is on
206:        * the network and the serial console still works.
207:        */
208: 
209:       printf("net: web_tool not started (%d)\n", ret);
210:     }
211: }

241: /****************************************************************************
242:  * Name: kvdb_loader
243:  *
244:  * Description:
245:  *   Injects the stored LLM settings into the agent's config file and joins
246:  *   the stored Wi-Fi network.
247:  *
248:  *   A task rather than part of bring-up because association blocks on the CP,
249:  *   and blocking bring-up stops the mailbox from being serviced: the
250:  *   heartbeat lapses and the CP's 8-second watchdog resets the chip.  Here a
251:  *   slow answer only delays this one task.
252:  *
253:  *   The store is memory-only, so on a cold boot there is nothing to inject
254:  *   and nothing to join; both calls are no-ops until something is set with
255:  *   `kvdb set`.
256:  *
257:  ****************************************************************************/
258: 
259: static int kvdb_loader(int argc, FAR char *argv[])
260: {
261:   UNUSED(argc);
262:   UNUSED(argv);
263: 
264:   /* Seed regardless: bk7258_kvdb_load() only ever reports "memory only" now,
265:    * and a value typed during this boot is just as good as a stored one.
266:    * bk7258_kvdb_seed_agent_config() returns without writing when the keys
267:    * are not there.
268:    */
269: 
270:   (void)bk7258_kvdb_load();
271:   bk7258_kvdb_seed_agent_config();
272: 
273: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_WIFI
274:   /* Whether or not the load worked: credentials typed during this boot are
275:    * just as usable as credentials read back from flash.
276:    *
277:    * Association, DHCP and the console service, in that order and from this
278:    * task -- see bk7258_net_autostart().  It replaced a bare
279:    * bk7258_kvdb_apply_wifi() call here: associating without asking for an
280:    * address left the interface RUNNING at NuttX's default 10.0.0.2, which
281:    * looks configured and routes nowhere.
282:    */
283: 
284:   bk7258_net_autostart();
285: #endif
286: 
287:   return 0;
288: }
289: 
290: /****************************************************************************
291:  * Name: bk7258_report_cache
292:  *
293:  * Description:
294:  *   Reports whether this core implements instruction and data caches, and is
295:  *   left in at boot so the next person does not have to guess.
296:  *
297:  *   The AP executes in place from flash at 0x02150000.  NuttX did not enable
298:  *   the instruction cache until commit "perf(bk7258): enable the AP
299:  *   instruction cache", and every instruction fetch was a flash access: the
300:  *   expression renderer cost ~455ms per frame for work that takes 0.09ms on a
301:  *   host, a 51200-byte word-at-a-time copy ran at 0.8MB/s, and raising the
302:  *   core to 480MHz changed none of it because the core was never the limit.
303:  *   The same frame now costs 37ms.
304:  *
305:  *   Turning it on needed two independent fixes, and the first one alone looks
306:  *   like "the cache does nothing": CONFIG_ARMV8M_ICACHE depends on the hidden
307:  *   ARMV8M_HAVE_ICACHE, which this chip's Kconfig did not select, so asking
308:  *   for it in a defconfig was silently dropped; and selecting it only compiles
309:  *   up_enable_icache() in -- every other ARMv8-M chip in the tree calls that
310:  *   from its own start code, this one did not.  Both are fixed now (see the
311:  *   chip Kconfig and bk7258_start.c).
312:  *
313:  *   Only the I-Cache is on.  Instruction fetch is read-only and needs no
314:  *   maintenance against the camera, panel and mailbox DMA that shares AP RAM,
315:  *   which the MPU deliberately keeps non-cacheable.
316:  *
317:  *   CLIDR/CTR exist in ARMv8-M whether or not a cache is fitted (they read
318:  *   zero when it is not), so reading them is safe and settles the question:
319:  *   this part reports CLIDR=0x09200003, i.e. both caches are implemented.
320:  *
321:  ****************************************************************************/
322: 
323: static void bk7258_report_cache(void)
324: {
325:   uint32_t clidr = getreg32(0xe000ed78);   /* SCB->CLIDR */
326:   uint32_t ctr   = getreg32(0xe000ed7c);   /* SCB->CTR   */
327:   unsigned int l1 = clidr & 7;
328: 
329:   printf("cache: CLIDR=0x%08" PRIx32 " CTR=0x%08" PRIx32
330:          " L1=%s%s%s\n", clidr, ctr,
331:          (l1 & 1) != 0 ? "I" : "",
332:          (l1 & 2) != 0 ? "D" : "",
333:          l1 == 0 ? "none (uncached XIP from flash)" :
334:          (l1 == 3 ? " (separate I and D)" : ""));
335: }
336: 
337: void board_late_initialize(void)
338: {
339:   int ret = bk7258_bringup();
340: 
341:   bk7258_report_cache();
342: 
343:   if (ret < 0)
344:     {
345:       printf("board bring-up stopped, error=%d\n", ret);
346:       return;
347:     }
348: 
349:   printf("board bring-up initialization completed\n");
350: 
351:   /* GC9D01 QSPI panel bring-up smoke test.  board_app_finalinitialize()
352:    * (BOARDIOC_FINALINIT) is never invoked in this minimal, apps-less NSH
353:    * configuration (no CONFIG_BOARDCTL_FINALINIT, no apps/nshlib start-up
354:    * script caller), so the test entry point is invoked here instead, from
355:    * the unconditionally-called CONFIG_BOARD_LATE_INITIALIZE hook.  See
356:    * docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-29-gc9d01-lcd-bringup.md Task 3 Step 3.
357:    */
358: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_GC9D01_FB
359:   /* GC9D01 framebuffers, one per populated panel: fb_register() calls
360:    * up_fbinitialize(), which does the rail/reset/bus bring-up and the init
361:    * sequence and allocates a 51200-byte RGB565 framebuffer, then publishes
362:    * /dev/fb<display>.
363:    *
364:    * Both panels are registered unconditionally.  GC9D01 has no readable ID
365:    * register, so an unpopulated footprint cannot be distinguished from a
366:    * working panel -- every command still "completes".  Registering /dev/fb1
367:    * on a single-panel board therefore costs one unused 51200-byte buffer
368:    * and nothing else; refusing to register it would need board-variant
369:    * configuration that this board provides no way to detect.
370:    */
371: 
372:   {
373:     int display;
374:     int registered = 0;
375: 
376:     /* Both panels through reset and the command table in one pass, before
377:      * fb_register() asks for either of them.  The sequence is nearly all
378:      * waiting (20ms rail, 230ms reset pulse, 120ms after Sleep Out) and the
379:      * waits are the panels', not the bus's, so sharing them across the two
380:      * panels takes ~350ms off the time to the first pixel.  fb_register()
381:      * still calls up_fbinitialize() -> bk7258_gc9d01_panel_init(), which
382:      * finds its panel already up and returns.
383:      */
384: 
385:     (void)bk7258_gc9d01_panels_init((1 << GC9D01_NDISPLAYS) - 1);
386: 
387:     for (display = 0; display < GC9D01_NDISPLAYS; display++)
388:       {
389:         ret = fb_register(display, 0);
390:         if (ret < 0)
391:           {
392:             printf("fb_register(%d) failed: %d\n", display, ret);
393:             continue;
394:           }
395: 
396:         registered |= 1 << display;
397:         printf("fb: /dev/fb%d registered\n", display);
398:       }
399: 
400:     /* Boot greeting, written out rather than simply appearing.
401:      *
402:      * The panel has no readable ID register, so "the init sequence was sent"
403:      * has never been evidence that it worked; something has to be drawn at
404:      * boot or a dead panel looks exactly like a working one.
405:      *
406:      * Both panels are revealed together, one stroke segment per step, so the
407:      * word is written left to right.  The step count is the whole cost: the
408:      * panel takes no partial update, so every step pushes a full 51200-byte
409:      * frame to each panel at ~25ms, and the stroke rendering adds to that.
410:      * 20 steps measured 1677ms and was by itself most of the delay between
411:      * reset and a readable screen; 8 steps measured 408ms on the same board
412:      * and still reads as writing rather than appearing.  Keep it at 8 unless
413:      * there is a measurement to justify more.
414:      *
415:      * The pen-stroke version of this lives in the 'hello' shell command,
416:      * which has a proper stroke font.  It cannot be reused here: it is an
417:      * application, and this configuration builds neither exec_builtin() nor
418:      * posix_spawn(), so bring-up has no way to start it.
419:      */
420: 
421:     if (registered != 0)
422:       {
423:         (void)bk7258_gc9d01_fb_hello_animate(registered, 8);
424:       }
425:   }
426: #endif
427: 
428:   /* GC2145 camera: registered as a standard V4L2 /dev/video0 node here
429:    * (imgdata+imgsensor framework, see bk7258_camera_bringup.c), superseding
430:    * the older bare board_late_initialize() smoke-test call this line used
431:    * to make directly.  The old bk7258_gc2145_test() bare entry point is
432:    * kept as an independent NSH command (see bk7258_appinit.c) for
433:    * side-by-side diagnostic comparison, per design discussion in
434:    * docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-30-gc2145-camera-bringup.md -- it is
435:    * intentionally NOT called from here anymore, so a bug in this new V4L2
436:    * driver cannot be masked by (or confused with) the old direct-call
437:    * path still running unconditionally at boot. */
438:   (void)bk7258_camera_initialize();
439: 
440: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_AUDIO
441:   /* Internal-DAC audio.  This has to come after bk7258_bringup() above,
442:    * not from inside it, for the same reason the camera does: the AUD block
443:    * needs the AUDP power domain and the AUD module clock, and both are
444:    * requested from CP1 over the PWC mailbox channel that bk7258_pwc_start()
445:    * brings up.  Registering the audio devices is best-effort -- a failure
446:    * here must not take the console down with it.
447:    */
448: 
449:   (void)bk7258_audio_initialize();
450: #endif
451: 
452: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_JPEG_ENC
453:   /* After the camera: both want PSRAM, and registering the encoder second
454:    * keeps /dev/video0 belonging to capture and /dev/video1 to this codec no
455:    * matter how the framework numbers them internally.  Best-effort, like the
456:    * others -- a codec that fails to register must not take the console down.
457:    */
458: 
459:   (void)bk7258_jpeg_enc_initialize();
460: #endif
461: 
462:   /* Configuration that survives a reset.  Deliberately after the display and
463:    * the camera: it talks to the CP's flash service over the mailbox and can
464:    * wait up to a second if that service does not answer, which is not
465:    * something the boot screen should queue behind.  A failure here is
466:    * reported and ignored -- the board still runs, it just forgets settings on
467:    * reset, which is what it did before this existed.
468:    */
469: 
470:   /* In-memory store now; the flash side is done by kvdb_loader below.
471:    * Nothing here may block on the CP -- see bk7258_kvdb_init().
472:    */
473: 
474:   (void)bk7258_kvdb_init();
475: 
476:   /* Leave the panels showing the product's own idle state rather than the
477:    * boot greeting.  From here on the screen is event driven: it is repainted
478:    * when a state or a result changes and at no other time, which is what the
479:    * spec requires ("屏幕仅事件触发刷新，不运行实时 Camera Preview").
480:    */
481: 
482:   (void)bk7258_status_screen_state(BK7258_STATUS_IDLE);
483: 
484: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_BLUETOOTH
485:   /* Last, so that nothing a user can see waits on the radio.  See
486:    * bk7258_bt_bringup() above for why this is not part of bk7258_bringup().
487:    */
488: 
489:   bk7258_bt_bringup();
490: #endif
491: 
492:   /* Last, and detached: see kvdb_loader(). */
493: 
494:   if (kthread_create("kvdb_loader", SCHED_PRIORITY_DEFAULT, 3072,
495:                      kvdb_loader, NULL) < 0)
496:     {
497:       printf("bk7258_bringup: kvdb_loader not started; settings will not "
498:              "survive a reset\n");
499:     }
500: #ifdef CONFIG_LVX_USE_DEMO_CONTEST2026_264_VELASIGHT
501:   /* The greeting is synchronous.  Start the app after board initialization. */
502:   ret = velasight_autostart();
503:   if (ret < 0)
504:     {
505:       printf("velasight autostart failed: %d\n", ret);
506:     }
507: #endif
508: }

478: static netif_if_t bk_network_auto_reconnect(bool val)	//val true means from disconnect to reconnecting
479: {
480: 	BK_FAST_CONNECT_D info = {0};
481:     netif_if_t netif_if = NETIF_IF_INVALID;
482:     //TODO np
483: #if 0
484: 	//bk_config_read("d_network_id", (void *)&info, sizeof(BK_FAST_CONNECT_D));
485: #else
486:     bk_get_env_enhance("d_network_id", (void *)&info, sizeof(BK_FAST_CONNECT_D));
487: #endif
488:     if ((info.flag & 0x8000l) != 0x8000l) {
489: 		BK_LOGI(TAG, "Please do network provisioning fisrtly\r\n");
490: 		return NETIF_IF_INVALID;
491: 	}
492: 	if (info.flag & BIT(NETIF_IF_STA)) {
493: 		np_sta_start((char *)info.sta_ssid, (char *)info.sta_pwd);
494: 		netif_if = NETIF_IF_STA;
495: 	}
496: 	else if (info.flag & BIT(NETIF_IF_AP)) {
497: 		np_softap_start((char *)info.ap_ssid, (char *)info.ap_pwd, info.ap_channel);
498: 		netif_if = NETIF_IF_AP;
499: 	}
500: #if CONFIG_NET_PAN
501: 	else if (info.flag & BIT(NETIF_IF_PAN)) {
502: 		pan_service_init();
503: 		bt_start_pan_reconnect();
504: 		netif_if = NETIF_IF_PAN;
505: 	}
506: #endif
507: #if CONFIG_BK_MODEM
508: 	else if (info.flag & BIT(NETIF_IF_PPP)) {
509: 		extern bk_err_t bk_modem_init(uint8_t comm_proto, uint8_t comm_if);
510: 		bk_modem_init(1, 1);
511: 		netif_if = NETIF_IF_PPP;
512: 	}
513: #endif
514: #if CONFIG_P2P
515: 	else if (info.flag & BIT(NETIF_IF_P2P)) {
516: 		int p2p_intent = info.p2p_go_intent;
517: 
518: 		if (p2p_intent <= 0 || p2p_intent > 15) {
519: 			p2p_intent = BK_NW_PRO_P2P_GO_INTENT_DEFAULT;
520: 		}
521: 		BK_LOGI(TAG, "P2P auto-reconnect: dev=%s intent=%d\n",
522: 			info.p2p_dev_name, p2p_intent);
523: 		bk_wifi_p2p_enable_with_intent((char *)info.p2p_dev_name, p2p_intent);
524: 		bk_wifi_p2p_find();
525: 		netif_if = NETIF_IF_P2P;
526: 	}
527: #endif
528: 
529:     if (netif_if != NETIF_IF_INVALID) {
530:         if (val == false) {
531: 			network_status_check_stop_timeout_check();
532: 			network_status_check_start_timeout_check(50);    //50s
533: 			bk_network_provisioning_update_status(BK_NETWORK_PROVISIONING_STATUS_RECONNECTING, NULL);
534: 			network_disc_evt_posted = 0;
535: 		}
536:     }
537: 	return netif_if;
538: }

    feat(provisioning): serve a Wi-Fi provisioning page and persist the credentials
    
    An application-callable entry for AP-mode provisioning: it starts a small HTTP
    server, serves one form, and writes the submitted SSID and passphrase to
    SD-NAND. It deliberately does not touch the Wi-Fi role -- no wapi, no
    ifup/ifdown, no association, no DHCPD -- because only the application knows when
    the network may drop. The saved callback therefore fires after the success page
    has been written and the connection closed; the other order makes a successful
    save look like a failed submit on the phone.
    
      int velasight_provisioning_start(const struct velasight_prov_config_s *cfg);
      int velasight_provisioning_stop(void);
      int velasight_provisioning_load(struct velasight_prov_credentials_s *out);
    
    The callback carries only a status and a monotonic generation, never the
    credentials, so a passphrase does not travel through every callback that only
    wanted the notification.
    
    The record is fixed-size, versioned, length-checked and CRC-protected, written to
    a scratch file and renamed over the target; a decode failure is treated as
    corrupt rather than repaired. The passphrase is stored in the clear and that is
    stated plainly: VFAT has no permission model to rely on and this part has no
    confirmed device key, so what is controlled instead is that it is never logged,
    never echoed back, and only read through the public API. The HTTP surface refuses
    everything it does not recognise, since the listener sits on an open access point
    with no authentication.
    
    Three constraints were found only on hardware and are pinned by tests, a Kconfig
    dependency and comments:
    
      - NET_TCPBACKLOG is required. Without it there is no POLLIN on a listening
        socket and accept() has no timeout, so a stoppable listener cannot be built;
        the symptom was a service that reported "listening" and answered nothing.
      - the store path must fit 8.3, because that SD-NAND is VFAT without long-name
        support: a "velasight" directory and a "wifi-provision.bin" file were both
        rejected with -EINVAL, and appending ".tmp" to a name that already had an
        extension produced a two-dot name that was equally invalid.
      - a missing directory reads as -ENOENT rather than the filesystem's -ENOTDIR,
        so an unprovisioned device does not look like a broken one.
    
    The parsing, the record and the HTTP surface carry no NuttX includes and the
    server needs only POSIX sockets, so the accept loop, the callback ordering and
    one-shot mode are all covered on the host: 160 checks. The provision_web command
    adds a loopback selftest, which passed 14/14 in STA mode and again in SoftAP.

63: 
64: 首版不直接实现 `wlan0 + wlan1` 并发，原因如下：
65: 
66: - 当前 `bk7258_wifi.c` 只有一个 lower-half、一个 carrier、一个 RX queue 和一组
67:   TX slot。
68: - 当前 TX 的 `co_hdr.vif_idx` 被清零，实际固定发送到 wire VIF 0，即 STA。
69: - 当前 RX 未读取 `co_hdr.vif_idx`，无法把 STA 和 SoftAP 帧分派给不同 netdev。
70: - 当前 CP 的 `CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_AP_IPV4` 只把普通 STA 的 ARP/IPv4 交给
71:   OpenVela，SoftAP 流量和 DHCP server 仍由 CP lwIP 持有。
72: - 直接注册第二张网卡只能得到一个不可用的接口，并会造成 CP lwIP 与 NuttX
73:   同时响应 DHCP/ARP。
74: 
75: 首版完成后再评估双网卡共存。双网卡不是本方案首版完成定义的一部分。
76: 
77: ### 1.2.1 当前项目选定方案
78: 
79: 结合当前产品需求，正式选择“单 `wlan0` STA/SoftAP 互斥运行时切换”作为首选
80: 实施方案：
81: 
82: - 平时 `wlan0` 运行 STA，维持设备的常规联网功能。
83: - 用户进入配置或文件服务模式后，允许关闭 STA，切换同一 `wlan0` 为 SoftAP。
84: - SoftAP 由 OpenVela/NuttX 提供 IPv4、ARP、DHCP 和本地 HTTP/File Server 数据面。
85: - 配置完成后停止 SoftAP，不重启单片机，恢复 STA 并重新获取地址。
86: - 不要求 STA 和 SoftAP 同时工作，不承担双网卡、NAT、bridge 和同信道并发风险。
87: 
88: 该方案满足“常用 STA、配置时可关闭 STA 换用 AP、切换不可重启”的要求。这里的
89: “热切换”表示设备运行期间完成角色切换，不表示网络连接和 socket 无损保持。
90:

196: ## 3. 目标架构与所有权
197: 
198: ### 3.1 控制面
199: 
200: ```text
201: NSH/WAPI
202:   -> NuttX wireless_ops
203:   -> BK7258 role state machine
204:   -> pointer-free OpenVela AP command
205:   -> Mailbox WIFI_CMD 0x14
206:   -> CP controller_if
207:   -> bk_wifi_ap_set_config/start/stop
208:   -> RWNX/hostapd/MAC/PHY/RF
209:   -> AP start/stop/client event
210:   -> Mailbox WIFI_CMD 0x44
211:   -> carrier/client state
212: ```
213: 
214: CP 继续独占射频、RWNX、hostapd、认证、关联和真实 VIF。OpenVela 不链接
215: Armino Wi-Fi 库，也不直接访问 Wi-Fi 寄存器。
216: 
217: ### 3.2 数据面
218: 
219: ```text
220: SoftAP client Ethernet frame
221:   -> CP Wi-Fi RX
222:   -> 保留 EAPOL 给 CP hostapd
223:   -> 普通 ARP/IPv4 标记 wire VIF 1
224:   -> Mailbox WIFI_DATA 0x45
225:   -> OpenVela RX worker
226:   -> NuttX wlan0
227:   -> DHCP server / local socket
228: 
229: NuttX wlan0 TX
230:   -> TX CPDU vif_idx=1
231:   -> Mailbox WIFI_DATA 0x15
232:   -> CP wire-to-LMAC VIF 映射
233:   -> SoftAP client
234: ```
235: 
236: ### 3.3 唯一所有者规则
237: 
238: SoftAP 模式下必须固定：
239: 
240: - CP 拥有 EAPOL、WPA2 handshake、hostapd、射频和 station association。
241: - NuttX 拥有 SoftAP 的 ARP、IPv4、UDP/TCP、DHCP server 和本地 socket。
242: - CP 不为 SoftAP 地址配置 IPv4，不启动 CP DHCP server，不响应 SoftAP ARP。
243: - 同一 SoftAP 上不得同时运行 CP DHCP server 和 NuttX DHCP server。
244: - CP 保留 `g_uap`/VIF 元数据只用于 Wi-Fi 数据路径映射，不能因此取得 L3
245:   所有权。
246: 
247: 只启动 Beken 热点、继续让 CP 托管 DHCP/IP 的方案不作为交付方案。它无法形成
248: 可由 OpenVela 应用使用的 `wlan0` 数据面。
249: 
250: ## 4. 模式与状态机
251: 
252: ### 4.1 状态
253: 
254: ```text
255: DOWN
256:   -> IDLE
257:       -> STA_STARTING -> STA_UP -> STA_STOPPING -> IDLE
258:       -> AP_STARTING  -> AP_UP  -> AP_STOPPING  -> IDLE
259:       -> ERROR -> IDLE
260: ```
261: 
262: 状态至少拆分：
263: 
264: - `admin_up`：NuttX interface 是否 up。
265: - `configured_role`：WAPI 最近配置的 `INFRA` 或 `MASTER`。
266: - `active_role`：CP 当前实际运行的角色。
267: - `sta_associated`：STA 关联状态。
268: - `ap_started`：SoftAP 是否已开始发 beacon。
269: - `ap_client_count`：已关联客户端数量。
270: - `carrier`：投射到 NuttX 的链路状态。
271: 
272: ### 4.2 状态规则
273: 
274: - `wapi mode` 只允许 `IW_MODE_INFRA` 和 `IW_MODE_MASTER`。
275: - active role 运行时修改 mode 返回 `-EBUSY`；用户必须先执行 disconnect。
276: - STA carrier 在 STA connected event 后打开，在 disconnected event 后关闭。
277: - SoftAP carrier 在 AP start success event 后打开，在 AP stop/fail 后关闭。
278: - AP client join/leave 只更新 client count，不得切换 carrier。
279: - AP active 时扫描首版返回 `-EBUSY`，避免扫描影响 beacon/channel。
280: - `ifdown` 必须停止 active role、关闭 carrier、阻止新 TX，并有界等待旧 TX
281:   ownership 完成；不能只改本地标志。
282: - peer reset 后 active role 变为 unknown，carrier off；重新查询 CP status 后才可
283:   恢复，不能猜测 SoftAP 仍在运行。
284: 
285: ### 4.3 配置隔离
286: 
287: STA 与 SoftAP 使用独立 pending config，至少包括：
288: 
289: ```text
290: STA: ssid, password, auth
291: AP:  ssid, password, security, channel, hidden, max_clients
292: ```
293: 
294: 切换 mode 不能让上一次 STA 密码静默成为 AP 密码，也不能让旧 AP 密码污染下一次
295: 开放热点配置。
296: 
297: ### 4.4 产品运行时序
298: 
299: #### 常规 STA 模式
300: 
301: ```text
302: STA_ONLINE
303:   -> wlan0 连接外部路由器
304:   -> DHCP client 获取地址
305:   -> 维持云端或其他外部网络连接
306: ```
307: 
308: #### 进入配置/文件服务模式
309: 
310: ```text
311: STA_ONLINE
312:   -> ENTER_CONFIG
313:   -> 关闭云端新请求并停止现有网络连接
314:   -> 停止 STA DHCP client
315:   -> STA disconnect/stop
316:   -> 等待 STA disconnected event
317:   -> 清理 STA 地址、路由、TX/RX 状态
318:   -> wlan0 切换到 SoftAP
319:   -> AP start success
320:   -> 设置 AP 静态 IPv4
321:   -> 启动 NuttX DHCP server
322:   -> 启动 HTTP/File Server
323:   -> AP_SERVING
324: ```
325: 
326: #### 退出配置/文件服务模式
327: 
328: ```text
329: AP_SERVING
330:   -> 停止接受新的 HTTP/File 请求
331:   -> 等待或取消在途文件操作
332:   -> 停止 DHCP server
333:   -> SoftAP stop
334:   -> 等待 AP stop event
335:   -> 清理 AP 地址、客户端计数、TX/RX 状态
336:   -> wlan0 切换到 STA
337:   -> 恢复 STA 配置和 STA MAC
338:   -> STA start/connect
339:   -> connected event
340:   -> DHCP renew
341:   -> 恢复云端或其他外部网络连接
342:   -> STA_ONLINE
343: ```
344: 
345: 切换期间不重启单片机，但以下连接状态不保留：
346: 
347: - STA 的 TCP/TLS/MQTT 等外部连接需要关闭并重建。
348: - AP 客户端在退出配置模式时会断开，需要重新关联。
349: - STA 与 AP 的 IPv4 地址、默认路由和 DHCP 状态必须分别清理和重新建立。
350: - HTTP/File Server 进程可以继续运行，但只能在 AP 地址有效且 `AP_SERVING`
351:   状态下对外提供服务。
352: 
353: ### 4.5 运行时切换兼容性要求
354: 
355: 本方案不依赖系统重启，但必须把切换设计成有界状态机：
356: 
357: - 切换前拒绝新的网络业务请求，避免应用继续创建外部 socket。
358: - 停止 active role 后等待对应 CP stop/disconnect event，不以发送 command 成功
359:   作为角色已停止的依据。
360: - 切换前关闭 DHCP client/server，清除旧 IP、网关、DNS 和默认路由。
361: - 阻止新 TX，等待 in-flight TX completion；超时对象进入 quarantine，不能直接
362:   复用共享 buffer。
363: - 清理旧 RX queue，给 RX packet 记录 role，禁止旧 STA frame 被 AP 模式消费，或
364:   反向消费。
365: - 切换 SoftAP/STA 时使用对应角色 MAC，不使用 base MAC 猜测替代。
366: - AP carrier 只有在 AP start success event 后打开，STA carrier 只有在 STA
367:   connected event 后打开。
368: - AP 模式下 HTTP/File Server 只绑定 AP 静态地址；STA 恢复后外部网络服务再绑定
369:   新的 STA 地址或由应用重新建立连接。
370: - 任意 command timeout、CP reset 或 event 丢失都进入 `ERROR`，关闭 carrier 和
371:   DHCP，禁止直接跳到下一角色。
372: 
373: 目标体验是“设备不重启、网络角色可恢复”，不是“网络业务零中断”。实际切换时间
374: 以实板为准，方案目标为 STA 到 AP 可访问约 3 至 8 秒，AP 到 STA 恢复联网约 3
375: 至 15 秒；STA 重新关联和 DHCP 可能使时间进一步增加。
376: 
377: ## 5. Pointer-free SoftAP Wire ABI
378: 
379: ### 5.1 不直接复用 pointer API
380: 
381: CP 的 `cif_wifi_api` 中部分 `AP_SET_CONFIG` API 把参数解释为 CP 可解引用的
382: `wifi_ap_config_t *`。OpenVela 不得跨核传递 NuttX pointer，也不得复制由编译宏、
383: bitfield 和 packing 决定的完整私有结构作为长期 ABI。
384: 
385: 旧 `BK_CMD_START_AP` 虽然是固定 payload，但存在以下问题：
386: 
387: - security 依赖密码长度隐式推导。
388: - 5 GHz 拒绝路径不返回正常 confirmation。
389: - confirmation 在实际 AP start 前发送，无法表示 start 最终结果。
390: - 无 protocol version、配置长度和 SoftAP MAC/status 查询。
391: 
392: 为避免改变原 AVDK AP 的 legacy command 语义，建议增加 OpenVela 专用 command：
393: 
394: ```text
395: 0x210 BK_CMD_OPENVELA_AP_START
396: 0x211 BK_CMD_OPENVELA_AP_STOP
397: 0x212 BK_CMD_OPENVELA_AP_STATUS
398: ```
399: 
400: ### 5.2 建议结构
401: 
402: ```c
403: struct bk7258_wifi_ap_start_request
404: {
405:   uint8_t version;
406:   uint8_t channel;
407:   uint8_t security;
408:   uint8_t hidden;
409:   uint8_t max_clients;
410:   uint8_t ssid_length;
411:   uint8_t password_length;
412:   uint8_t reserved;
413:   uint8_t ssid[32];
414:   uint8_t password[64];
415: };
416: 
417: struct bk7258_wifi_ap_status_response
418: {
419:   int32_t status;
420:   uint8_t started;
421:   uint8_t channel;
422:   uint8_t security;
423:   uint8_t client_count;
424:   uint8_t mac[6];
425:   uint8_t reserved[2];
426: };
427: ```
428: 
429: 实现时必须为 `sizeof`、字段 offset 和 reserved=0 增加两侧 `_Static_assert`。
430: 所有字符串按显式长度解析，CP 落地到 Beken API 前再复制并补 NUL，禁止对 wire
431: 数组直接调用无界 `strlen()`。
432: 
433: ### 5.3 输入校验
434: 
435: AP 和 CP 两侧都必须检查：
436: 
437: - `version` 是双方支持的版本。
438: - SSID 长度为 1 至 32 字节。
439: - Open 模式 password 长度必须为 0。
440: - WPA2-PSK password 长度为 8 至 63 字节。
441: - channel 符合当前 country code。
442: - `hidden` 只能为 0 或 1。
443: - `max_clients` 在 1 至 Beken driver 上限内。
444: - `reserved` 全零。
445: - payload 长度必须精确匹配结构大小。
446: 
447: 普通日志不得打印 SSID 对应的密码或完整 command payload。
448: 
449: ## 6. OpenVela AP 侧修改方案
450: 
451: ### 6.1 `bk7258_wifi_ipc.h`
452: 
453: 新增：
454: 
455: - OpenVela AP command/event 命名常量。
456: - wire VIF 常量：STA=0、SoftAP=1。
457: - 固定宽度 AP request/response。
458: - CPDU `flags` 中 `vif_idx` 的 mask/shift helper，避免 C bitfield ABI。
459: - AP start/stop/assoc/disassoc event payload。
460: - 全部结构的 size/offset assertion。
461: 
462: 禁止引入 `wifi_ap_config_t`、lwIP 类型或 FreeRTOS 类型。
463: 
464: ### 6.2 `bk7258_wifi.c` 控制面
465: 
466: 调整：
467: 
468: - 用 role state mutex 保护 mode/config/start/stop/event。
469: - `wifi_connect()` 按 configured role 分派 STA connect 或 SoftAP start。
470: - `wifi_disconnect()` 按 active role 分派 STA disconnect 或 SoftAP stop。
471: - `wifi_mode()` 校验角色和状态，不再无条件保存任意值。
472: - `wifi_passwd()` 根据 WAPI algorithm 写入角色独立配置。
473: - 实现 `wifi_freq()`，将 channel 作为 AP pending config；active AP 不在线修改。
474: - `wifi_auth()` 只接受首版能够实际执行的 Open/WPA2 参数，未支持值返回
475:   `-EOPNOTSUPP`。
476: - AP config validation 在发送 command 前完成一次，CP 再完成第二次。
477: - 解析 AP start/stop/client events，维护 `ap_started/client_count/carrier`。
478: - 初始化和 peer-reset 恢复时通过 AP status command 取得 SoftAP MAC 与真实状态。
479: 
480: ### 6.3 `bk7258_wifi.c` 数据面
481: 
482: 调整：
483: 
484: - TX slot 保存发送时的 wire role。
485: - STA TX 设置 `vif_idx=0`，SoftAP TX 设置 `vif_idx=1`。
486: - RX 校验并提取 CPDU `vif_idx`。
487: - 首版只接收 active role 对应的 frame；其他 role frame 计数并按原 ownership
488:   协议归还 CP。

73: ## SoftAP 模式
74: 
75: 以下配置已在 BK7258 实板验证手机可发现并连接热点：
76: 
77: ```sh
78: ifdown wlan0
79: ifup wlan0
80: wapi mode wlan0 3
81: wapi freq wlan0 6 1
82: wapi psk wlan0 12345678 3
83: wapi essid wlan0 VelaSight_AP 1
84: dhcpd_start wlan0
85: ```
86: 
87: 其中：
88: 
89: - `3` 表示 `WAPI_MODE_MASTER` 或 WPA-CCMP。
90: - channel 固定为 6，可按现场 2.4 GHz 信道占用改为 1 至 13。
91: - WPA2 密码必须为 8 至 63 字节。
92: - `dhcpd_start` 会将板端配置为 `192.168.10.1/24`。
93: - DHCP 地址池为 `192.168.10.2` 起，最多分配 4 个租约。
94: 
95: 检查运行状态：
96: 
97: ```sh
98: ifconfig wlan0
99: wapi show wlan0
100: ```
101: 
102: 成功时 `ifconfig` 必须显示 `RUNNING`，`wapi show` 应显示
103: `WAPI_MODE_MASTER`、目标 ESSID、channel 和 AP MAC。只有 `UP` 而没有
104: `RUNNING` 表示配置已保存，但 CP 尚未成功启动 beacon。
105: 
106: 手机连接：
107: 
108: ```text
109: SSID: VelaSight_AP
110: 密码: 12345678
111: IP 设置: DHCP/自动
112: ```
113: 
114: 停止 SoftAP：
115: 
116: ```sh
117: dhcpd_stop
118: ifdown wlan0
119: ```
120: 
121: 切回 STA：
122: 
123: ```sh
124: ifup wlan0
125: wapi mode wlan0 2
126: wapi psk wlan0 <路由器密码> 3
127: wapi essid wlan0 <2.4G_SSID> 1
128: renew wlan0
129: ifconfig wlan0
130: ```
131: 
132: ## 故障排查
133: 
134: - `dhcpd_start: command not found`：当前 AP 分区不是启用 SoftAP DHCP 的最新
135:   `nsh` 镜像。`help` 的 `Builtin Apps` 必须包含 `dhcpd_start` 和 `dhcpd_stop`。
136: - 手机扫描不到热点：先检查 `ifconfig wlan0` 是否为 `RUNNING`；`wapi show`
137:   只能证明配置已保存，不能单独证明热点已经发 beacon。
138: - 重复启动 DHCP 前先执行 `dhcpd_stop`，避免旧服务仍占用 UDP 端口 67。
139: - SoftAP 模式不支持与 STA 并发；切换角色前必须停止当前角色。
140: 
141: ## 注意
142: 
143: - 不要把真实 Wi-Fi 密码提交到仓库或测试日志中。开放热点不涉及这个问题。
144: - 示例 SoftAP 密码仅用于开发测试，产品使用时必须替换。

text:
**结论**

合入他人分支中的 AP server 实际上是一个完整度较高的“AP 模式 Wi-Fi 配网页面服务”，但它运行在比赛仓的 OpenVela/NuttX AP 侧，不是 `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/ap` 里的 Armino AP 固件。

它已经具备：

- SoftAP 网络建立后的 HTTP 监听
- 手机访问的中文 Wi-Fi 配网页面
- SSID、密码提交和校验
- 凭据持久化
- 保存成功回调
- 保存后安全停止服务
- 主机侧表单、HTTP、存储和 server 测试

它还没有具备：

- 自动切换到 SoftAP
- 自动配置 AP IP
- 自动启动 DHCP server
- 自动切回 STA
- 将配网凭据写入 `app_ab` 当前 CP 使用的 EasyFlash 配置
- 在 `app_ab` 的 FreeRTOS/Armino AP 镜像中直接运行

因此，接入 `app_ab` AP 模式时，需要把它当成“HTTP 配网业务层”复用，另外实现一层 Armino AP 网络适配和凭据存储适配。

---

**一、合入分支 AP server 的现有功能**

主要代码在：

- [vp_server.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/provisioning_web/vp_server.c)
- [vp_http.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/provisioning_web/vp_http.c)
- [vp_form.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/provisioning_web/vp_form.c)
- [vp_store.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/provisioning_web/vp_store.c)
- [velasight_provisioning.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/provisioning_web/include/velasight_provisioning.h)

该功能由提交 `197c411 feat(provisioning): serve a Wi-Fi provisioning page and persist the credentials` 引入。

### 1. HTTP 接口

当前 HTTP 表面非常小：

| 请求 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| `GET /` | 返回配网页面 |
| `GET /index.html` | 返回同一个配网页面 |
| `POST /save` | 接收 SSID 和密码 |
| 其他路径 | `404` |
| 其他方法 | `405` |

表单格式：

```text
application/x-www-form-urlencoded
```

字段：

```text
ssid=<SSID>&password=<password>
```

POST 必须带：

```text
Content-Length
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
```

明确拒绝：

- chunked transfer encoding
- 缺少 `Content-Length`
- 非表单类型
- 超过 512 字节的 body
- 超过 2048 字节的请求头
- 不支持的路径或方法
- 重复 `ssid` 或 `password` 字段

服务一次只处理一个 TCP 连接，处理完成后主动关闭连接。

### 2. 页面内容

页面是内嵌 HTML/CSS：

- 中文页面
- SSID 输入框
- 密码输入框
- 支持开放 Wi-Fi
- 不依赖 JavaScript
- 不依赖外部 CSS、字体或网络资源

原因是手机连接 SoftAP 时通常没有互联网访问，页面必须完全自包含。

### 3. 凭据校验

SSID：

- 长度 1 到 32 字节
- 不允许控制字符
- 允许 UTF-8 字节内容

密码：

- 留空表示开放网络
- 非空时必须为 8 到 63 字节
- 只允许可打印 ASCII
- 不允许密码出现在日志或 HTTP 回显中

校验入口：

```c
vp_credentials_validate()
vp_form_parse()
```

### 4. 存储格式

凭据保存到默认路径：

```text
/mnt/sdnand/prov/wifi.bin
```

文件是固定 114 字节的版本化二进制记录：

| 偏移 | 内容 |
|---:|---|
| 0 | `VSWP` 魔数 |
| 4 | 版本 |
| 6 | flags，bit0 表示开放网络 |
| 8 | generation |
| 12 | SSID 长度 |
| 13 | 密码长度 |
| 14 | SSID |
| 46 | 密码 |
| 109 | 保留字节 |
| 110 | CRC32 |

保存流程：

```text
vpsave.tmp
  -> fwrite
  -> fflush
  -> fsync
  -> close
  -> rename
  -> sync
```

该实现考虑了 SD-NAND VFAT 的限制：

- 目录和文件名必须符合 8.3
- 临时文件固定命名为 `vpsave.tmp`
- 不使用 `wifi-provision.bin`
- 不使用 `wifi.bin.tmp`
- 记录包含 CRC 和长度校验
- 损坏记录返回 `-EBADMSG`

需要注意：密码在 NAND 中是明文保存的。当前实现只做到：

- 不打印密码
- 不通过 HTTP 回显密码
- 不在回调中传递密码
- 通过公共 API 显式读取

并没有实现加密存储。

### 5. 生命周期和回调

公共 API：

```c
int velasight_provisioning_start(
    const struct velasight_prov_config_s *config);

int velasight_provisioning_stop(void);

bool velasight_provisioning_is_running(void);

uint32_t velasight_provisioning_generation(void);

int velasight_provisioning_load(
    struct velasight_prov_credentials_s *out);
```

启动配置：

```c
struct velasight_prov_config_s
{
  uint16_t                  port;
  bool                      one_shot;
  const char               *store_path;
  velasight_prov_saved_cb_t on_saved;
  void                     *cb_arg;
};
```

关键时序：

```text
手机 POST /save
    -> 校验凭据
    -> 写入存储
    -> 返回成功页面
    -> 关闭 TCP 连接
    -> 调用 on_saved()
```

回调故意放在关闭连接之后。这样应用可以在回调里停止 DHCP、停止 SoftAP、切回 STA，而不会截断手机已经收到的成功页面。

这部分设计是正确的，也是接入 AP 配网时最应该保留的行为。

### 6. 服务本身不管理 Wi-Fi

代码和文档都明确声明：

```text
provisioning_web 不调用 wapi
provisioning_web 不调用 ifup/ifdown
provisioning_web 不关联 Wi-Fi
provisioning_web 不启动 DHCPD
provisioning_web 不切换 STA/AP
```

它假设调用者已经完成：

```text
切到 SoftAP
配置 AP 静态 IP
启动 DHCP server
启动 HTTP server
```

对应文档中的手工流程：

```sh
ifdown wlan0
ifup wlan0
wapi mode wlan0 3
wapi freq wlan0 6 1
wapi psk wlan0 <password> 3
wapi essid wlan0 VelaSight_AP 1
dhcpd_start wlan0
provision_web run
```

---

**二、当前 VelaSight OpenVela AP 模式已经有什么**

VelaSight 的网络层在：

- [vs_network.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/velasight/vs_network.c)
- [vs_app.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/velasight/vs_app.c)

现有 `vs_network_apply_ap()` 已经完成：

```text
关闭 wlan0
拉起 wlan0
配置 WAPI master 模式
配置 AP SSID/密码/channel
设置 192.168.0.1/24
启动 NuttX dhcpd
```

代码路径：

```c
vs_network_request_mode(network, VS_NET_AP)
    -> vs_network_apply_ap()
```

其中 SoftAP 的默认参数来自 Kconfig：

```text
CONFIG_VS_AP_SSID
CONFIG_VS_AP_PASSWORD
CONFIG_VS_AP_CHANNEL
```

当前默认值：

```text
SSID: VelaSight_AP
密码: 12345678
信道: 6
```

AP 模式的数据面已经是 OpenVela/NuttX 所有：

- ARP
- IPv4
- DHCP server
- TCP
- UDP
- 本地 socket 服务

SoftAP 方案文档明确规定：

```text
CP 负责：
- 射频
- hostapd
- WPA2 握手
- STA/AP 关联

OpenVela/NuttX 负责：
- SoftAP ARP
- IPv4
- DHCP
- TCP/UDP
- HTTP/File Server
```

这正好满足 `provisioning_web` 的运行前提。

但是当前 VelaSight 仍然只有预留接口：

```c
int vs_softap_service_start(void);
int vs_softap_service_stop(void);
```

目前实现是弱符号：

```c
int weak_function vs_softap_service_start(void)
{
  return -ENOSYS;
}
```

所以现在的真实状态是：

```text
SoftAP 可以启动
DHCP 可以启动
provisioning_web 源码已经合入并编译
但 VelaSight 还没有把 provisioning_web 启停接到 AP 状态机
```

另外，VelaSight 的 UI 中也明确留下了未完成逻辑：

```c
/* Credential reset belongs to the future SoftAP service. */
```

---

**三、`app_ab` AP 固件当前实际状态**

`app_ab` 的 AP 工程：

```text
bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/ap
```

当前入口只有：

[ap_main.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/ap/ap_main.c)

```c
int main(void)
{
    bk_init();
    return 0;
}
```

CMake 也只编译：

```cmake
set(srcs
    ap_main.c
)
```

因此它当前不是一个应用层 AP server 工程，而是 CPU1/AP 侧的基础启动固件。

### `app_ab` AP 配置的现状

当前 AP 配置中：

```text
CONFIG_LWIP=y
CONFIG_LWIP_V2_1=y
CONFIG_BK_NETIF=y
CONFIG_NETIF_LWIP=y
CONFIG_HTTP=y
CONFIG_HTTP_OTA_WITH_BLE=y
CONFIG_BK_NTWK_TRANSFER=y
```

但以下配置关闭：

```text
CONFIG_BK_NETWORK_PROVISIONING is not set
CONFIG_WIFI_ENABLE is not set
CONFIG_WIFI_SOFTAP is not set
CONFIG_LWIP_HTTPD is not set
```

这说明：

- AP 侧有 lwIP
- AP 侧有通用网络组件
- AP 侧有 HTTP OTA 相关组件
- 但没有启用完整 SoftAP 配网组件
- 没有启用 lwIP 内置 HTTPD
- 没有启用 `bk_network_provisioning`
- 没有现成的 AP 配网页面服务

`app_ab` CP 侧则启用了：

```text
CONFIG_WIFI_ENABLE=y
CONFIG_BK_HOSTAPD=y
CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_CONTROLLER=y
CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_AP_IPV4=y
CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_OPENVELA_SOFTAP_IPV4=y
```

这说明当前系统的 Wi-Fi 控制和 SoftAP 射频能力主要属于 CP，OpenVela AP 侧通过 VNET 接收 SoftAP IPv4 数据。

---

**四、`bk_network_provisioning` 是否可以直接使用**

SDK 中确实有另一个 Beken 网络配网组件：

```text
ap/components/bk_network_provisioning
```

它提供：

```c
bk_network_provisioning_init()
bk_network_provisioning_start()
bk_register_network_provisioning_status_cb()
```

并且内部具备：

- STA 配置
- SoftAP 配置
- AP 静态 IP 设置
- `bk_wifi_ap_set_config()`
- `bk_wifi_ap_start()`
- AP 客户端事件
- DHCP/IP 状态事件
- EasyFlash 中的 `d_network_id`
- BLE 配网方案

但它不是当前需求中的 HTTP 页面方案。

代码中：

```c
case BK_NETWORK_PROVISIONING_TYPE_WEB:
    break;
```

Web 类型实际上没有实现服务逻辑。

当前 `app_ab/ap/config/bk7258_ap/config` 还关闭：

```text
CONFIG_BK_NETWORK_PROVISIONING
```

所以不能通过简单打开配置就得到 HTTP 配网。

它更像是一个已有的 BLE/控制流配网框架，而不是可以直接替代 `provisioning_web` 的 AP Web server。

---

**五、推荐的接入方式**

推荐沿用当前 VelaSight 的单 `wlan0`、STA/AP 互斥架构，把 `provisioning_web` 接在 OpenVela AP 应用层。

目标运行链路：

```text
VelaSight UI 请求进入配网
    -> 停止 STA 业务
    -> 关闭 STA DHCP/外部连接
    -> wlan0 切换为 SoftAP
    -> 设置 AP 静态 IP
    -> 启动 NuttX DHCP server
    -> 启动 provisioning_web HTTP server
    -> 手机连接 SoftAP
    -> 手机 GET /
    -> 手机 POST /save
    -> 凭据写入 SD-NAND
    -> 返回成功页面
    -> TCP 连接关闭
    -> saved callback
    -> 停止 provisioning_web
    -> 停止 DHCP
    -> 停止 SoftAP
    -> 将凭据转换到 STA 配置
    -> 切回 STA
    -> 关联新路由器
    -> DHCP renew
    -> 回到正常页面
```

这里不建议把 HTTP server 放到 Armino `app_ab/ap` 中，理由是：

1. 当前 `app_ab/ap` 只是 CPU1/AP 基础启动工程，应用入口很薄。
2. 当前 SoftAP IPv4 数据面已经设计为 OpenVela/NuttX 所有。
3. `provisioning_web` 使用的是 NuttX POSIX socket、pthread、文件系统和 NuttX DHCP 配套。
4. 如果 HTTP 服务放到 Armino AP 侧，会和 OpenVela SoftAP IPv4 数据面产生所有权冲突。
5. 现有设计要求 SoftAP 下 CP 不再持有 DHCP/ARP/IPv4，不能让 Armino lwIP 再启动一套 SoftAP DHCP/HTTP 网络栈。

因此应保持：

```text
CP / Armino：
- hostapd
- WPA2
- AP beacon
- station association
- Wi-Fi control

OpenVela / NuttX：
- wlan0 netdev
- SoftAP IPv4
- ARP
- DHCP server
- provisioning_web HTTP server
- 保存凭据
```

---

**六、最小代码接入方案**

### 方案 A：直接实现现有弱符号

在 `app/velasight` 中新增，例如：

```text
vs_provisioning.c
```

实现：

```c
int vs_softap_service_start(void)
{
    struct velasight_prov_config_s cfg;

    memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
    cfg.port = 80;
    cfg.one_shot = true;
    cfg.on_saved = vs_provisioning_saved;
    cfg.cb_arg = NULL;

    return velasight_provisioning_start(&cfg);
}

int vs_softap_service_stop(void)
{
    return velasight_provisioning_stop();
}
```

然后在 `vs_network.c` 的 AP/STA 模式切换中接入：

```text
AP 启动成功
    -> vs_softap_service_start()
```

```text
AP 停止前
    -> vs_softap_service_stop()
```

但保存回调不能直接在 listener 线程里同步执行完整 STA 切换，因为回调是在 server listener pthread 中触发的，切换 Wi-Fi 可能阻塞并涉及底层状态机。

更稳妥的方式是：

```text
saved callback
    -> 只设置 pending flag / 投递事件
    -> VelaSight 主任务处理事件
    -> stop provisioning service
    -> 切换网络模式
```

当前 `velasight_provisioning_stop()` 支持在回调中调用，但这只适合停止监听，不建议在 listener 线程中直接执行整个 AP 到 STA 的长流程。

### 方案 B：把配网逻辑放进 `vs_network.c`

可以让 `vs_network.c` 管理：

```c
vs_network_request_mode(VS_NET_AP)
```

之后启动服务：

```c
vs_softap_service_start();
```

保存成功后由网络状态机处理：

```c
VS_NET_AP_CONFIG_SAVED
    -> 读取 velasight_provisioning_load()
    -> 更新 STA 配置
    -> 停止 HTTP
    -> 停止 DHCP
    -> ifdown wlan0
    -> 切换 STA
```

这比让 `vs_app.c` 直接处理 Wi-Fi 细节更合适，因为网络切换和服务生命周期属于同一个模块。

---

**七、必须解决的存储适配问题**

当前 `provisioning_web` 保存格式和当前 VelaSight STA 配置不是同一套存储。

当前 VelaSight STA 配置来自：

```c
CONFIG_VS_STA_SSID
CONFIG_VS_STA_PASSWORD
```

由：

```c
vs_config_load_wifi()
```

加载。

这意味着配网页面保存成功后，当前代码并不会自动影响 STA 连接。必须增加运行时配置来源。

推荐优先级：

```text
SD-NAND provisioning record
    > Kconfig 默认值
```

修改 `vs_config_load_wifi()`：

```text
1. 先调用 velasight_provisioning_load()
2. 如果返回 0：
   - 使用保存的 SSID
   - 使用保存的密码
3. 如果返回 -ENOENT：
   - 回退到 CONFIG_VS_STA_SSID/PASSWORD
4. 如果返回 -EBADMSG：
   - 进入配置错误或配网流程
```

建议不要把密码再次复制到 KVDB，原因：

- `provisioning_web` 已有独立、版本化、CRC 保护的存储格式
- 避免产生两份不同步的凭据
- 避免通过 `kvdb list`、调试工具等路径扩大密码暴露面

只有在 `bk7258_wifi_config.c` 或其他已有底层连接链路强制要求 `kvdb` 的情况下，才考虑在应用层显式同步到 KVDB。

---

**八、SoftAP 参数应如何处理**

当前 SoftAP 参数仍来自：

```text
CONFIG_VS_AP_SSID
CONFIG_VS_AP_PASSWORD
CONFIG_VS_AP_CHANNEL
```

这是合理的，因为 SoftAP 是让手机连接设备进行配网，设备端热点凭据不等于目标路由器凭据。

建议保留：

```text
AP SSID:
  Kconfig 默认值，后续可改为设备序列号派生

AP password:
  Kconfig 默认值，产品版本应改为设备唯一或随机凭据

AP channel:
  Kconfig 默认值，范围 1-13
```

不要把用户填写的目标 Wi-Fi 密码设置成 SoftAP 密码。

---

**九、需要补充的配置和构建接入**

比赛仓当前已经启用：

```text
CONFIG_LVX_USE_DEMO_CONTEST2026_264_PROVISION_WEB=y
CONFIG_NET_TCP=y
CONFIG_NET_TCPBACKLOG=y
CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPD=y
CONFIG_BK7258_SDIO=y
CONFIG_BK7258_SDNAND_AUTOMOUNT=y
```

因此 OpenVela/NuttX 侧基础依赖已经满足。

需要补充：

1. `velasight/CMakeLists.txt` 加入 `vs_provisioning.c`
2. `vs_provisioning.c` include：
   ```c
   #include "velasight_provisioning.h"
   ```
3. AP 成功后启动 `velasight_provisioning_start()`
4. STA 切换前停止服务
5. `vs_config_load_wifi()` 读取 provisioning record
6. 保存回调改成事件通知，而不是直接执行完整切换
7. UI 增加配网中、保存成功、切换 STA、失败状态
8. AP 服务启动失败时进入明确错误状态
9. 关闭 SoftAP 时先停止 HTTP，再停 DHCP，再停 Wi-Fi

建议顺序：

```text
停止 HTTP
停止 DHCP
ifdown wlan0
切换 STA/AP
```

而不是先关闭 Wi-Fi，否则正在提交的 socket 会被异常切断。

---

**十、当前最重要的风险**

### 1. 不要在 AP/Armino 侧再启动第二套 SoftAP DHCP

`app_ab` AP 配置有 lwIP，但当前项目的 SoftAP IPv4 ownership 已经交给 OpenVela/NuttX。

不能同时存在：

```text
NuttX dhcpd
Armino/lwIP DHCP server
```

否则会出现：

- 两个 DHCP server 同时响应
- 客户端拿到错误网关
- ARP 冲突
- HTTP 服务绑定到错误的网络栈
- OpenVela `wlan0` 看似 UP 但没有有效数据面

### 2. HTTP 服务端口 80 可能有冲突

当前 `provisioning_web` 默认监听：

```text
80
```

需要确认 OpenVela 镜像中没有其他服务占用端口 80。当前 `web_tool` 默认是另一种 TCP 服务，并不等于 HTTP server，但仍应在实板上检查。

### 3. `one_shot` 与显式 stop 的状态处理

建议配网服务设置：

```c
one_shot = true
```

保存成功后 listener 会自然退出，但应用仍需要做一次状态回收和线程 reap。应确保下一次进入配网前调用：

```c
velasight_provisioning_stop()
```

或让服务封装层统一处理 `VP_STATE_FINISHED`。

### 4. SD-NAND 挂载时序

`provisioning_web` 依赖：

```text
/mnt/sdnand
```

当前 SDIO/SD-NAND 是延迟初始化，AP 模式入口必须确认 SD-NAND 已经挂载，否则：

```text
vp_store_save()
```

会失败。

### 5. `vs_network_apply_sta()` 当前不支持开放网络

当前 STA 逻辑无条件设置：

```c
wifi.auth_wpa = WPA_VER_2;
wifi.cipher_mode = IW_AUTH_CIPHER_CCMP;
wifi.alg = WPA_ALG_CCMP;
```

而配网页面允许开放网络。

如果要支持页面中的“密码留空表示开放网络”，STA 应用路径也要增加：

```text
open_network:
  不设置 WPA2 加密参数
```

否则开放网络虽然成功保存，切回 STA 时仍可能按 WPA2 去关联。

### 6. 配网服务当前只存储，不验证目标路由器

页面提交后只验证格式并写盘，不会：

- 切换到 STA
- 尝试关联
- 验证密码是否正确
- 获取 DHCP 地址
- 报告最终连接结果

因此产品行为应明确为：

```text
保存成功 != 路由器连接成功
```

完整产品流程应在回调后增加：

```text
切回 STA
关联
DHCP
确认 GOT_IP
成功或失败反馈
```

---

**推荐最终架构**

```text
VelaSight UI
    |
    v
vs_network_request_mode(VS_NET_AP)
    |
    +-- CP: Start SoftAP / WPA2 / beacon
    +-- NuttX: wlan0 carrier
    +-- NuttX: 192.168.0.1/24
    +-- NuttX: dhcpd_start()
    +-- NuttX: velasight_provisioning_start()
                              |
                              v
                       phone GET /
                       phone POST /save
                              |
                              v
                       SD-NAND /mnt/sdnand/prov/wifi.bin
                              |
                              v
                       save event
                              |
                              v
                  VelaSight network state machine
                              |
                              +-- stop HTTP
                              +-- stop DHCP
                              +-- stop SoftAP
                              +-- load credentials
                              +-- apply STA
                              +-- DHCP renew
                              +-- update UI
```

核心判断是：

```text
复用 provisioning_web 的 HTTP、表单校验和持久化格式；
不要复用 app_ab AP 侧的 lwIP 作为第二套 SoftAP 数据面；
将服务启动/停止接入 OpenVela 的 VelaSight SoftAP 状态机；
将保存记录作为 STA 凭据的唯一运行时来源。
```

27: static int vs_network_apply_sta(struct vs_network_s *network)
28: {
29:   struct wpa_wconfig_s wifi;
30:   int ret;
31: 
32:   ret = wapi_set_ifdown(network->sock, "wlan0");
33:   if (ret < 0 && ret != -ENODEV)
34:     return ret;
35: 
36:   ret = wapi_set_ifup(network->sock, "wlan0");
37:   if (ret < 0)
38:     return ret;
39: 
40:   memset(&wifi, 0, sizeof(wifi));
41:   wifi.ifname = "wlan0";
42:   wifi.sta_mode = WAPI_MODE_MANAGED;
43:   wifi.auth_wpa = WPA_VER_2;
44:   wifi.cipher_mode = IW_AUTH_CIPHER_CCMP;
45:   wifi.alg = WPA_ALG_CCMP;
46:   wifi.ssid = network->config.sta_ssid;
47:   wifi.ssidlen = strlen(wifi.ssid);
48:   wifi.passphrase = network->config.sta_password;
49:   wifi.phraselen = strlen(wifi.passphrase);
50: 
51:   ret = wpa_driver_wext_associate(&wifi);
52:   if (ret < 0)
53:     return ret;
54: 
55:   ret = netlib_obtain_ipv4addr("wlan0");
56:   if (ret < 0)
57:     return ret;
58: 
59:   network->mode = VS_NET_STA;
60:   network->status.mode = VS_NET_STA;
61:   network->status.state = VS_NET_STA_READY;
62:   snprintf(network->status.ssid, sizeof(network->status.ssid), "%s",
63:            network->config.sta_ssid);
64:   snprintf(network->status.address, sizeof(network->status.address),
65:            "STA READY");
66:   return 0;
67: }

69: static int vs_network_apply_ap(struct vs_network_s *network)
70: {
71:   struct wpa_wconfig_s wifi;
72:   struct in_addr address;
73:   struct in_addr netmask;
74:   int ret;
75: 
76:   if (network->config.ap_channel < 1 || network->config.ap_channel > 14 ||
77:       network->config.ap_ssid[0] == '\0')
78:     return -EINVAL;
79: 
80:   ret = wapi_set_ifdown(network->sock, "wlan0");
81:   if (ret < 0 && ret != -ENODEV)
82:     return ret;
83: 
84:   ret = wapi_set_ifup(network->sock, "wlan0");
85:   if (ret < 0)
86:     return ret;
87: 
88:   memset(&wifi, 0, sizeof(wifi));
89:   wifi.ifname = "wlan0";
90:   wifi.sta_mode = WAPI_MODE_MASTER;
91:   wifi.auth_wpa = WPA_VER_2;
92:   wifi.cipher_mode = IW_AUTH_CIPHER_CCMP;
93:   wifi.alg = WPA_ALG_CCMP;
94:   wifi.freq = network->config.ap_channel;
95:   wifi.flag = WAPI_FREQ_FIXED;
96:   wifi.ssid = network->config.ap_ssid;
97:   wifi.ssidlen = strlen(wifi.ssid);
98:   wifi.passphrase = network->config.ap_password;
99:   wifi.phraselen = strlen(wifi.passphrase);
100: 
101:   ret = wpa_driver_wext_associate(&wifi);
102:   if (ret < 0)
103:     return ret;
104: 
105:   address.s_addr = htonl(0xc0a80a01);
106:   netmask.s_addr = htonl(0xffffff00);
107:   ret = netlib_set_ipv4addr("wlan0", &address);

114:   ret = dhcpd_start("wlan0");

116:     return ret;
117:   network->dhcp_running = true;
118:   network->mode = VS_NET_AP;
119:   network->status.mode = VS_NET_AP;
120:   network->status.state = VS_NET_AP_READY;
121:   snprintf(network->status.ssid, sizeof(network->status.ssid), "%s",
122:            network->config.ap_ssid);
123:   snprintf(network->status.address, sizeof(network->status.address),
124:            "192.168.10.1");

134:     return -EINVAL;
135:   n = calloc(1, sizeof(*n));

137:     return -ENOMEM;

145:   ret = vs_config_load_wifi(&n->config);
146:   if (ret < 0)

149:       free(n);
150:       return ret;
151:     }

174:                             vs_network_apply_sta(network);
175:   if (ret < 0)
176:     {
177:       network->status.state = VS_NET_ERROR;
178:       network->status.error = ret;
179:     }

107: static void vs_switch_network(struct vs_display_s *display,
108:                               struct vs_runtime_s *runtime,
109:                               struct vs_network_s *network)
110: {
111:   enum vs_net_mode_e mode = runtime->network.mode == VS_NET_STA ?
112:                             VS_NET_AP : VS_NET_STA;
113: 
114:   runtime->error_back_progress = false;
115:   runtime->progress = 0;
116:   runtime->page = VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING;
117:   runtime->progress = 100;
118:   vs_render(display, runtime);

120:   if (vs_network_request_mode(network, mode) < 0)
121:     {
122:       (void)vs_network_get_status(network, &runtime->network);
123:       runtime->error = runtime->network.error;
124:       runtime->page = VS_PAGE_ERROR;
125:     }
126:   else
127:     {
128:       (void)vs_network_get_status(network, &runtime->network);
129:       runtime->page = runtime->network.mode == VS_NET_AP ?
130:                       VS_PAGE_SOFTAP : VS_PAGE_HISTORY;

134: static void vs_handle_event(struct vs_display_s *display,
135:                             struct vs_runtime_s *runtime,
136:                             struct vs_network_s *network,
137:                             const struct vs_input_event_s *event)
138: {
139:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_COMBO_PROGRESS &&
140:       (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_HISTORY ||
141:        runtime->page == VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING))
142:     {
143:       runtime->page = VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING;
144:       runtime->progress = event->progress;
145:       return;
146:     }
147: 
148:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_COMBO_CANCEL &&
149:       runtime->page == VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING &&
150:       runtime->network.mode == VS_NET_STA)
151:     {
152:       runtime->page = VS_PAGE_HISTORY;
153:       runtime->progress = 0;
154:       return;
155:     }
156: 
157:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_PROGRESS && event->key == VS_KEY_CONFIRM &&
158:       (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_HISTORY ||
159:        runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ENTER))
160:     {
161:       runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ENTER;
162:       runtime->progress = event->progress;
163:       return;
164:     }
165: 
166:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_PROGRESS && event->key == VS_KEY_BACK &&
167:       (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING ||
168:        runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSED ||
169:        runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_EXITING))
170:     {
171:       if (runtime->page != VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_EXITING)
172:         {
173:           runtime->social_exit_from_paused =
174:             runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSED;
175:         }
176: 
177:       runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_EXITING;
178:       runtime->progress = event->progress;
179:       return;
180:     }
181: 
182:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_PROGRESS && event->key == VS_KEY_BACK &&
183:        (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOFTAP ||
184:         (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING &&
185:          runtime->network.mode == VS_NET_AP) ||
186:         runtime->page == VS_PAGE_ERROR))
187:     {
188:       if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_ERROR)
189:         {
190:           runtime->error_back_progress = true;
191:         }
192:       else
193:         {
194:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING;
195:         }
196: 
197:       runtime->progress = event->progress;
198:       return;
199:     }
200: 
201:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_CANCEL && event->key == VS_KEY_CONFIRM &&
202:       runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ENTER)
203:     {
204:       runtime->page = VS_PAGE_HISTORY;
205:       runtime->progress = 0;
206:       return;
207:     }
208: 
209:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_CANCEL && event->key == VS_KEY_BACK &&
210:       (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING ||
211:        runtime->page == VS_PAGE_ERROR))
212:     {
213:       if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING)
214:         {
215:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOFTAP;
216:         }
217: 
218:       runtime->progress = 0;
219:       runtime->error_back_progress = false;
220:       return;
221:     }
222: 
223:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_NET_TOGGLE &&
224:       (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_HISTORY ||
225:        runtime->page == VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING) &&
226:       network != NULL)
227:     {
228:       vs_switch_network(display, runtime, network);
229:       return;
230:     }
231: 
232:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_SHORT)
233:     {
234:       if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_HISTORY)
235:         {
236:           if (event->key == VS_KEY_CONFIRM)
237:             {
238:               /* Keep a visible assistant entry page until the voice backend
239:                * is connected in the next implementation phase. */
240:               runtime->page = VS_PAGE_VOICE_LISTENING;
241:             }
242:           else if (event->key == VS_KEY_BACK)
243:             runtime->page = VS_PAGE_HISTORY;
244:           else if (event->key == VS_KEY_NEXT)
245:             {
246:               runtime->index = (runtime->index + 1) %
247:                                (sizeof(g_history) / sizeof(g_history[0]));
248:               runtime->view = VS_HISTORY_SUMMARY;
249:             }
250:         }
251:       else if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING &&
252:                event->key == VS_KEY_CONFIRM)
253:         {
254:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSED;
255:         }
256:       else if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSED &&
257:                event->key == VS_KEY_CONFIRM)
258:         {
259:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING;
260:         }
261:       else if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_VOICE_LISTENING &&
262:                event->key == VS_KEY_CONFIRM)
263:         {
264:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_VOICE_THINKING;
265:         }
266:       else if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ENTER &&
267:                event->key == VS_KEY_CONFIRM)
268:         {
269:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_VOICE_LISTENING;
270:           runtime->progress = 0;
271:         }
272:       else if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_EXITING &&
273:                event->key == VS_KEY_BACK)
274:         {
275:           runtime->page = runtime->social_exit_from_paused ?
276:                           VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSED : VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING;
277:           runtime->progress = 0;
278:         }
279:       else if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING &&
280:                runtime->network.mode == VS_NET_AP &&
281:                event->key == VS_KEY_BACK)
282:         {
283:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOFTAP;
284:           runtime->progress = 0;
285:         }
286:       else if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_VOICE_SPEAKING)
287:         {
288:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_HISTORY;
289:         }
290:       else if (event->key == VS_KEY_BACK &&
291:                runtime->page != VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING &&
292:                runtime->page != VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSED &&
293:                runtime->page != VS_PAGE_SOFTAP &&
294:                runtime->page != VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING)
295:         {
296:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_HISTORY;
297:           runtime->progress = 0;
298:           runtime->error_back_progress = false;
299:         }
300:     }
301:   else if (event->type == VS_INPUT_LONG)
302:     {
303:       if ((runtime->page == VS_PAGE_HISTORY ||
304:            runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ENTER) &&
305:           event->key == VS_KEY_CONFIRM)
306:         {
307:           runtime->progress = 100;
308:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING;
309:         }
310:       else if ((runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING ||
311:                 runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSED ||
312:                 runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_EXITING) &&
313:                event->key == VS_KEY_BACK)
314:         {
315:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_HISTORY;
316:         }
317:       else if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOFTAP &&
318:                event->key == VS_KEY_CONFIRM)
319:         {
320:           /* Credential reset belongs to the future SoftAP service. */
321:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOFTAP;
322:         }
323:       else if ((runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOFTAP ||
324:                 (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING &&
325:                  runtime->network.mode == VS_NET_AP)) &&
326:                event->key == VS_KEY_BACK && network != NULL)
327:         {
328:           vs_switch_network(display, runtime, network);
329:         }
330:       else if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_ERROR && event->key == VS_KEY_BACK)
331:         {
332:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_HISTORY;
333:           runtime->progress = 0;
334:           runtime->error_back_progress = false;
335:         }
336:     }
337: }

339: int vs_app_run(void)
340: {
341:   struct vs_display_s *display = NULL;
342:   struct vs_input_s *input = NULL;
343:   struct vs_network_s *network = NULL;
344:   struct vs_runtime_s runtime;
345:   struct vs_input_event_s event;
346:   int ret;
347: 
348:   memset(&runtime, 0, sizeof(runtime));
349:   runtime.page = VS_PAGE_HISTORY;
350:   runtime.view = VS_HISTORY_SUMMARY;
351:   runtime.network.mode = VS_NET_STA;
352:   runtime.network.state = VS_NET_DOWN;
353: 
354:   ret = vs_display_open(&display);
355:   if (ret < 0)
356:     return ret;
357:   ret = vs_input_open(&input);
358:   if (ret < 0)
359:     goto fail;
360:   ret = vs_network_open(&network);
361:   if (ret < 0)
362:     {
363:       runtime.network.state = VS_NET_ERROR;
364:       runtime.network.error = ret;
365:     }
366: 
367:   runtime.agent = velaclaw_client_open("velasight");
368:   if (runtime.agent == NULL)
369:     {
370:       printf("velasight: ai_agent client unavailable\n");
371:     }
372: 
373:   vs_render(display, &runtime);
374:   for (;;)
375:     {
376:       if (vs_input_poll(input, &event) > 0)
377:         {
378:           enum vs_page_e previous = runtime.page;

11: ## 1. 目标与范围
12: 
13: 本 App 面向 BK7258 上的 OpenVela/NuttX，使用三枚物理按键和两块 160x160
14: GC9D01 圆形 RGB565 显示器，完成以下设备端闭环：
15: 
16: - 上电默认进入 Wi-Fi STA 模式和历史记录索引界面。
17: - 浏览本地轻量历史索引，一屏显示记录索引信息，另一屏显示摘要或情绪比例。
18: - 在历史记录页短按确认键启动闲时语音助手；助手只附带当前屏幕选中的一条记录。
19: - 在无记录的空白页短按确认键时先拍摄一张照片，将照片和本轮语音问题交给通用
20:   多模态 Agent，不创建社交会话，也不保存为社交历史。
21: - 语音录制由端侧音量检测自动判断尾静音并截断，也可再次短按确认键手动截断；
22:   返回键短按可在录音、云端处理或 TTS 播放期间取消。
23: - 语音助手期间索引屏改为显示“聆听、识别、思考、播报、已取消、失败”等状态，
24:   收到回答后以 TTS 为主要输出，屏幕只保留一至两行摘要。
25: - 在历史界面长按确认键进入社交辅助模式，显示进入进度和操作提示。
26: - 社交辅助期间采集 Camera/Audio、与统一云端接口通信，并显示实时情绪和简短建议。
27: - 社交模式演示基线按约 20 至 30 秒的一次明确会话设计：历史页长按 Power 开始、
28:   社交中长按返回结束；
29:   代码不写死 20 秒上限，长会话扩展留到演示闭环之后。
30: - 社交图像起步目标为可信 3 FPS，采一张即上传一张；能力允许后挑战 5 FPS。音频按
31:   2 秒一块持续上传，由云端按 `session_id` 和时间戳拼接。
32: - 短按确认键暂停/继续社交采集；长按返回键结束会话、等待最终结果、落盘后回到最新记录。
33: - 在历史界面同时长按返回键和下一个键，请求在 STA 与 SoftAP 间切换。
34: - SoftAP 界面显示热点名和密码，长按确认键请求随机重置凭据。
35: - 以有限分辨率下的简洁、可扫视、低刷新交互为首要设计原则。
36: 
37: 首版实现闲时语音助手，但不在设备端运行 ASR、大模型或复杂视觉推理。设备只完成
38: PCM 采集、轻量音量检测、上下文选择、可选单帧拍摄、请求编排和 TTS 播放；ASR、
39: 通用多模态理解和回答生成由设备上的现有 `ai_agent` 直接调用获准的模型 API 完成，
40: 不经过自建社交会话云。这里的“不经过云端”特指不经过团队自建中转云，并不表示端侧
41: 离线推理。系统不做人脸身份识别、人格判断、
42: 心理或医学诊断。云端内容必须使用“可能”等非确定性表达；数据不足时显示“无法判断”。

44: ## 2. 当前代码事实与约束

173: ### 4.2 事件模型
174: 
175: 所有异步来源写入同一个有界 App 事件队列：
176: 
177: ```text
178: button worker -----> key/progress event ----+
179: cloud worker ------> cue/result/error event +--> app loop --> state snapshot
180: media worker ------> started/stopped/error --+                  |
181: voice worker ------> vad/asr/answer/tts event +                  |
182: storage worker ----> loaded/stored/error ----+                  +--> display worker
183: network worker ----> sta/ap/up/down/error ---+
184: ```
185: 
186: - 队列满时不得丢失按键释放、结束、取消、VAD 截断、网络错误和最终结果事件。
187: - 可合并的低优先级事件只有长按进度、音量电平和连续实时情绪更新，保留最新值即可。
188: - 状态只由 App 主循环修改；worker 不共享写业务状态。
189: - 显示 worker 接收不可变快照，刷新时不持有媒体、网络或存储锁。
190: - 社交异常情绪即时事件与最终结果必须分成两类事件：即时事件只更新颜色/短文本/拉取标志，
191:   最终结果事件才允许写历史和启动最终 TTS。
192: 
193: ## 5. 双圆屏交互设计
194: 
195: 圆屏边角不可用，核心内容放在中心直径约 136 px 的安全区。首版不显示滚动长文，
196: 不使用细线、复杂图例或需要精确触控的元素。
197: 
198: ### 5.1 历史记录索引
199:

201: 
202: - 中央显示 `当前序号/总数`，例如 `03/12`。
203: - 上方显示短日期或“最新”；下方显示最长两行标题。
204: - 底部以三个简单图标/短词提示确认、返回、下一个。
205: - 有记录时短按确认进入当前实现的 `VOICE_LISTENING` 页面占位，长按确认进入社交占位状态。
206: - 当前历史数据为 `vs_app.c` 内置的三条静态记录，没有独立空白历史页和本地历史存储。
207: 
208: `/dev/fb1` 为概略屏：
209: 
210: - 默认显示一至两行摘要和状态标志（完整/incomplete/易失）。
211: - 目标设计中摘要与情绪饼图由下一个键按页面顺序切换；当前只有下一个键切换三条静态记录。

214: ### 5.2 社交模式进入与运行
215: 
216: 进入进度期间：
217: 
218: - 索引屏显示环形进度条和“继续按住”。
219: - 概略屏显示“松开取消 / 满圈开始”。
220: - 长按满圈后当前只进入 `SOCIAL_RUNNING` 占位页；尚未生成 `session_id` 或启动 Camera/Audio。
221:   运行中短按 Power 暂停/继续，返回键长按显示退出动画并返回历史页。
222: 
223: 运行期间：
224: 
225: - `/dev/fb0` 显示云端最新实时情绪名称、连接/暂停状态和数据新鲜度。
226: - `/dev/fb1` 显示最多两行社交提示；没有可靠线索时显示“继续倾听”或“无法判断”。
227: - 普通情绪识别结果不强制逐帧显示；只有云端标记 `emotion_changed`/强烈情绪时，
228:   才改变颜色并显示短文本。设备可依据标志主动拉取一次异常详情，避免高频返回大包。
229: - 异常详情优先显示颜色和短文本，不在会话中途播放 TTS，避免打断对话；云端大模型建议
230:   可以稍后作为结构化文本到达，但演示主输出留给会话结束后的最终 TTS。

232: - 极端情绪建议至少连续多个有效窗口且置信度过阈值后才显示，并设置冷却时间，
233:   防止屏幕颜色频繁跳变。
234: - 暂停时两屏加明显暂停符号，保留最后内容但降低饱和度。

236: ### 5.3 闲时语音助手
237: 
238: 目标设计：语音助手占用两屏期间不再显示可操作的历史索引。当前代码只实现页面占位，以下为后续闭环要求：
239: 
240: - `/dev/fb0` 显示大号状态词：准备、聆听、识别、思考、播报、取消或失败。
241: - `VOICE_LISTENING` 时显示低频更新的音量环和“Power 结束 / 返回取消”；音量环仅为
242:   反馈，不显示精确 dB，刷新不高于 10 Hz。
243: - 后续记录回顾路径的 `/dev/fb1` 可显示当前记录短标题；当前代码不显示照片预览、Prompt、
244:   回答摘要或 TTS 状态。
245: - 后续实现应在识别/思考阶段只显示阶段词，不显示完整字幕、Prompt 或历史正文。
246: - 当前没有独立取消语音请求或迟到回答的实现；失败页只由网络切换失败路径使用。
247: 
248: 端侧音量检测采用轻量 VAD，不引入神经网络模型：
249: 
250: 1. 录音开始先采集 300 至 500 ms 环境声建立 RMS 噪声底，但用户立即说话时不得把明显
251:    高能量语音吸收到噪声底。
252: 2. 以 20 ms PCM 窗计算去直流后的 RMS，阈值使用“噪声底乘数 + 最小绝对门槛”，并设置
253:    开始/结束不同阈值形成迟滞。
254: 3. 连续 3 至 5 个窗口超过开始阈值才判定开始说话；说话开始前保留约 300 ms pre-roll，
255:    避免吞掉首字。
256: 4. 已检测到语音后，连续约 800 ms 低于结束阈值自动截断。录音开始后若 5 秒仍无语音，
257:    显示“未听清”并取消请求。
258: 5. 最长录音默认 30 秒，到时强制截断；小于 300 ms 的有效语音不提交 ASR。
259: 6. VAD 使用增益前或固定增益 PCM 计算，不允许 AGC 将静音逐步放大成语音；阈值、尾静音、
260:    无语音和最长时长均放入 Kconfig，并通过实板噪声样本标定。
261: 
262: 建议调色板（RGB565 在实现时预计算）：
263: 
264: | 情绪 | 颜色 | 用途 |
265: | --- | --- | --- |
266: | 中性/未知 | 深灰 + 白字 | 常态背景 |
267: | 积极/愉悦 | 绿色 | 温和正向线索 |
268: | 困惑/不确定 | 黄色 | 注意和确认理解 |
269: | 悲伤/低落 | 蓝色 | 低唤醒负向线索 |
270: | 愤怒/强烈压力 | 红色 | 极端情绪强调 |
271: | 害怕/焦虑 | 洋红 | 高唤醒不安线索 |

273: ### 5.4 Finalizing 与结果返回（后续实现）

275: - 索引屏显示无无限动画的分段等待指示和“正在整理记录”。

**Findings**
1. **High: A failed credential save can leave SoftAP, DHCP, and HTTP running after the UI returns to normal operation.** `vs_network_process_events()` handles a negative save callback by setting an error and returning without stopping any AP resources (`app/velasight/vs_network.c:280-284`). The one-shot server only stops itself after a successful save, so it remains active after this failure (`app/provisioning_web/vp_server.c:379-390`). The app then enters the error page (`app/velasight/vs_app.c:393-400`), but a short Back press returns directly to history without requesting STA mode or otherwise tearing down HTTP, DHCP, or `wlan0` (`app/velasight/vs_app.c:293-301`). Thus a storage error followed by short Back leaves the provisioning network indefinitely active and hidden behind the history UI.

2. **High: A failed AP-to-STA transition records the mode as AP after AP resources have already been destroyed, preventing the user from re-entering provisioning.** The transition stops HTTP and DHCP first (`app/velasight/vs_network.c:233-248`) and then attempts STA association/DHCP (`app/velasight/vs_network.c:250-251`). `network->mode` and `status.mode` are changed to STA only after the complete STA operation succeeds (`app/velasight/vs_network.c:79-90`); on failure, only `state` and `error` are updated (`app/velasight/vs_network.c:252-256`). This is especially likely after submitting an incorrect router password. The UI continues to see `VS_NET_AP`, so network toggles choose STA again rather than AP (`app/velasight/vs_app.c:110-115`), repeatedly retrying the bad credentials with no path back to the provisioning hotspot short of restarting the application/device.

3. **Medium: The single NAND credential file is not power-loss-safe and has no interrupted-save recovery.** The save uses `rename(tmp, path)` and deletes the temporary file on failure (`app/provisioning_web/vp_store.c:350-354`). On this target, the existing destination is unlinked before the FAT rename, as the component itself documents (`app/provisioning_web/vp_store.h:94-98`). A power loss or rename failure in that interval therefore leaves neither a valid `wifi.bin` nor a recovery path. Loading only examines the final path and never recovers `vpsave.tmp` (`app/provisioning_web/vp_store.c:361-396`). On the next boot this becomes `-ENOENT`, and VelaSight silently uses the compiled Kconfig credentials (`app/velasight/vs_config.c:56-79`), losing the previously provisioned network.

4. **Medium: Delayed or corrupt NAND storage is silently bypassed as though the device had never been provisioned.** `first_load` is cleared before waiting for the delayed mount (`app/velasight/vs_config.c:35-47`). If the mount has not completed within the polling window, the load sees `-ENOENT`, falls back to Kconfig, and no later mount event reloads the existing NAND file (`app/velasight/vs_config.c:56-79`). The same fallback is deliberately applied to `-EBADMSG`, even though the provisioning API distinguishes corruption from absence (`app/velasight/vs_config.c:66-79`). This contradicts the nearby statement that Kconfig is only a first-boot fallback and can make a provisioned device associate using unrelated development credentials without surfacing the storage failure.

5. **Medium: Kconfig can enable the provisioning code without the TCP backlog support its server requires.** VelaSight uses `select LVX_USE_DEMO_CONTEST2026_264_PROVISION_WEB` (`app/velasight/Kconfig:9`), while the selected symbol has direct dependencies on `NET_TCP && NET_TCPBACKLOG` (`app/provisioning_web/Kconfig:6-10`). Kconfig `select` does not honor or propagate those dependencies. Enabling VelaSight in another configuration can therefore force the HTTP component on with unmet dependencies, producing a warning and a server whose listening socket cannot be polled as designed. The current `ai_agent` defconfig happens to enable both dependencies, but the integration itself does not enforce them correctly.

6. **Low: DHCP shutdown failures are discarded and the daemon is marked stopped regardless.** Normal AP exit ignores `dhcpd_stop()` and clears `dhcp_running` unconditionally (`app/velasight/vs_network.c:244-248`); close also ignores the result (`app/velasight/vs_network.c:315-317`). **Findings**

High findings: none. Four medium correctness findings remain.

1. **Medium: the NAND readiness wait can expire before a valid configured initialization can finish.** `vs_config_wait_for_store()` waits only 7 seconds (`app/velasight/vs_config.c:20-31`). The board can delay initialization by up to 60 seconds, with a 5-second default (`board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/Kconfig:48-56`, scheduled at `board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/src/bk7258_bringup.c:175-181`), and the subsequent MMCSD probe can itself wait another 7 seconds (`board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/src/bk7258_mmcsd.c:25-26`, `board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/src/bk7258_mmcsd.c:180-195`). Thus even the default timing can take roughly 12 seconds. If VelaSight times out first, `vs_network_open()` fails at `app/velasight/vs_network.c:218-225`; the app retains a null network handle and never retries, so neither STA nor provisioning AP is available for that boot.

2. **Medium: Kconfig permits VelaSight configurations in which its mandatory NAND backend can never become ready.** The VelaSight option only depends on framebuffer, buttons, and TCP (`app/velasight/Kconfig:1-10`), but `vs_config_wait_for_store()` unconditionally returns `-ENODEV` without `CONFIG_BK7258_SDIO` and waits forever-until-timeout if SDIO is enabled without automount (`app/velasight/vs_config.c:13-34`). There is no dependency on `BK7258_SDIO`, `BK7258_SDNAND_AUTOMOUNT`, or `FS_FAT`, even though the provisioning store defaults to VFAT-backed `/mnt/sdnand` (`app/provisioning_web/Kconfig:35-47`). Such configurations build successfully but always disable all VelaSight networking at runtime.

3. **Medium: scratch recovery masks real storage errors as “not provisioned” and can silently select the Kconfig credentials.** When the final record is absent, failure to open `vpsave.tmp` is always returned as `-ENOENT` at `app/provisioning_web/vp_store.c:398-402`, regardless of whether `fopen()` failed with `EIO`, `EACCES`, or another NAND/filesystem error. `vs_config_load_wifi()` treats `-ENOENT` as a clean first boot (`app/velasight/vs_config.c:67-80`) and then uses the Kconfig fallback (`app/velasight/vs_config.c:83-90`). A real scratch/NAND read failure can therefore make the device attempt the wrong network instead of reporting persistent-storage failure.

4. **Medium: a provisioning callback queued during manual AP exit is processed after the transition as if it still belonged to the current AP state.** The callback sets a persistent event flag at `app/velasight/vs_network.c:47-59`. AP-to-STA exit stops and joins the server but does not clear or consume that event (`app/velasight/vs_network.c:244-270`). Because the main loop checks callbacks before polling input (`app/velasight/vs_app.c:392-412`), a callback can arrive after that check and before a manual exit input is handled. On the next iteration, a stale failed-save event sets `VS_NET_AP_READY` at `app/velasight/vs_network.c:302-306` even though the mode is now STA, and the app moves back to the error page at `app/velasight/vs_app.c:397-402`. Clearing the AP generation’s pending event after the joined stop, or tagging events with an AP-session generation, is needed.

The previously targeted normal paths otherwise look addressed: failed saves leave the server available for another HTTP submission; ordinary AP-to-STA association/DHCP failures leave logical mode as STA so AP can be re-entered; close waits for provisioning shutdown before destroying the callback mutex; Make/CMake both expose the provisioning implementation; and VelaSight Wi-Fi no longer calls KVDB. The board KVDB loader’s Wi-Fi autostart is excluded for VelaSight at `board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/src/bk7258_bringup.c:273-286`.

Verification: `app/provisioning_web/tests` passed all 169 host checks, including the new scratch-recovery tests. A full target firmware build was not available from a configured build directory.

Entering AP can consequently terminate another caller’s active listener and callbacks. Cleanup should stop provisioning only when this AP attempt successfully started it.

已完成 VelaSight App 与 AP 配网组件的完整接入。

**实现结果**

- App 进入 AP 模式时依次执行：
  - 停止 STA
  - 启动 SoftAP
  - 设置 `192.168.10.1/24`
  - 启动 NuttX DHCP server
  - 启动配网 HTTP 服务
- 手机连接热点后访问：
  ```text
  http://192.168.10.1/
  ```
- AP 启动成功后双屏显示：
  - 左屏：热点名称
  - 右屏：热点密码和网页地址
- 页面保存成功后：
  - HTTP 成功响应先发送完毕
  - listener 线程关闭连接
  - 保存事件通过 mutex 交给 VelaSight 主循环
  - 主循环读取新凭据
  - 停止 HTTP server
  - 停止 DHCP server
  - 停止 SoftAP
  - 切换 STA 并申请 DHCP 地址
- 手动退出 AP 时也按同样顺序回收 HTTP、DHCP、接口和线程资源。
- 保存失败时保留 AP 和网页，允许用户重新提交。
- 新路由器关联失败时可重新进入 AP 配网，不会卡在已拆除的 AP 状态。
- 配网服务带显式所有权，不会错误停止手工启动的另一个 `provision_web` 实例。

**存储**

VelaSight Wi-Fi 持久化不再使用 KVDB。板级 KVDB Wi-Fi autostart 在 VelaSight 配置下已禁用。

所有目标 STA 凭据统一保存在一个 NAND 文件中：

```text
/mnt/sdnand/prov/wifi.bin
```

同一个 114 字节记录包含：

- SSID
- 密码
- 开放网络标志
- generation
- 格式版本
- CRC32

存储流程：

```text
vpsave.tmp -> fflush -> fsync -> close -> rename -> sync
```

新增断电恢复：

- 正式文件缺失但 `vpsave.tmp` 完整且 CRC 正确时，自动恢复为正式文件。
- scratch 损坏时返回 `-EBADMSG`，不会错误提升。
- NAND I/O 错误不会伪装成“尚未配网”。
- NAND 记录损坏时不会静默使用开发期路由器凭据，用户仍可进入 AP 重新配网。
- App 启动会等待 SD-NAND 实际挂载，最长等待覆盖合法的 automount 延迟和探测超时。

**构建接入**

- 配网核心重构为 `provision_web_core` 静态库。
- `provision_web` 调试命令和 `velasight` App 复用同一实现，不重复编译符号。
- Kconfig 已约束所需能力：
  - BK7258 Wi-Fi
  - IPv4、TCP、UDP
  - DHCP client/server
  - TCP backlog
  - SDIO、SD-NAND automount、FAT
  - waitpid
- SDK 仓构建产物和 Python 缓存已清理，SDK 工作区干净。

359:   runtime.page = VS_PAGE_HISTORY;

365:   if (ret < 0)
366:     return ret;
367:   ret = vs_input_open(&input);
368:   if (ret < 0)
369:     goto fail;
370:   ret = vs_network_open(&network);
371:   if (ret < 0)
372:     {
373:       runtime.network.state = VS_NET_ERROR;
374:       runtime.network.error = ret;
375:     }
376:   else if (vs_network_request_mode(network, VS_NET_STA) < 0)
377:     {
378:       (void)vs_network_get_status(network, &runtime.network);
379:       runtime.error = runtime.network.error;

384:   if (runtime.agent == NULL)
385:     {
386:       printf("velasight: ai_agent client unavailable\n");
387:     }
388: 
389:   vs_render(display, &runtime);
390:   for (;;)
391:     {
392:       if (network != NULL)
393:         {
394:           ret = vs_network_process_events(network);
395:           if (ret != 0)
396:             {
397:               (void)vs_network_get_status(network, &runtime.network);
398:               if (ret < 0)
399:                 {
400:                   runtime.error = ret;
401:                   runtime.page = VS_PAGE_ERROR;
402:                 }
403:               else
404:                 {
405:                   runtime.page = VS_PAGE_HISTORY;
406:                 }
407: 
408:               vs_render(display, &runtime);
409:             }
410:         }
411: 
412:       if (vs_input_poll(input, &event) > 0)
413:         {
414:           enum vs_page_e previous = runtime.page;
415: 
416:           vs_handle_event(display, &runtime, network, &event);
417:           if (runtime.page != previous || event.type == VS_INPUT_LONG ||
418:               event.type == VS_INPUT_CANCEL)
419:             {
420:               printf("velasight: input type=%u key=%u progress=%u "
421:                      "page=%u->%u\n", event.type, event.key,
422:                      event.progress, previous, runtime.page);

424: 
425:           vs_render(display, &runtime);

428:       usleep(CONFIG_VS_INPUT_POLL_MS * 1000);

432:   vs_network_close(network);
433:   vs_input_close(input);
434:   vs_display_close(display);
435:   return ret;
436: }

3:  *
4:  * The socket half of the provisioning entry.  Deliberately POSIX-only so the
5:  * accept loop, the ordering guarantee and one-shot mode can be exercised over
6:  * loopback on the host; the only thing left for the board is whether the
7:  * SoftAP and SD-NAND are actually there.
8:  *
9:  * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
10:  ****************************************************************************/
11:
